name: BL
label: IT work backlog
description: IT work waiting to be done, by sector and work type, fed by demand and drained by completion and abandonment.
notes: spec name from the recon C2 stock mapping; flows Demand, Comp and Aband are in BFY per year

name: ClientP
label: Client-perceived productivity
description: Each employer's productivity relative to 2024 as its clients perceive it, lagging actual productivity and used in pricing and sourcing.
notes: spec unit dimensionless; starts at 1 and smooths Pe, an index (2024 = 1)

name: ClientPRef
label: Client reference productivity
description: A slower smoothing of client-perceived productivity, the trend reference against which clients price.
notes: spec unit dimensionless; starts at 1; reads the ClientP already updated in the same step

name: PerceivedP
label: Perceived productivity
description: Employers' perception of their own productivity relative to 2024, lagging actual productivity and used to size desired headcount.
notes: spec unit dimensionless; starts at 1 and smooths Pe, an index (2024 = 1); loop B1

name: TightPerc
label: Perceived visa tightness
description: The visa tightness employers perceive and act on, lagging the policy tightness.
notes: on the 0-1 visa tightness scale (0 open, 1 closed; 0.3 in 2024), which is not 1 in 2024, so dimensionless; its flow flow:TightPerc is dimensionless per year

name: Attr0
label: 2024 voluntary attrition
description: Each vendor's 2024 voluntary exits per head a year, from quits, leaving the field and switch-outs, the R10 reference set on the first step.
notes: term: R10; read by loops.r10cost and VolAttr in vendor_books (finance); not integrated: set once from the first step's flows over headcount (sentinel -1 before), so fl.quits, fl.leave and sw.out are inputs, not inflows, and no stock-flow unit match applies

name: Dur0
label: 2024 seeker spell
description: The 2024 expected job-seeker spell length by region and level, the R4 reference set on the first step.
notes: term: R4; read by loops.r4mult; not integrated: set once from seekers over their outflows (sentinel -1 before), so hires is an input, not an inflow, and no stock-flow unit match applies

name: H
label: Headcount
description: Employed IT staff by model unit and level, the core people stock of each employer and location.
notes: spec indexes it by employer, region and level; the engine's units encode employer and location; spec unit persons, engine model-unit persons; in: fl.onboard, promo, sw.in, conv (OL); out: fl.promo_out, fl.quits, fl.leave, fl.retire, fl.layoffs, sw.out, expiry and conv (OV), all model-unit persons per year

name: LeftField
label: Left the field
description: A running total of people who have left the IT field, by region.
notes: accumulator; in: fl.leave, pool.rec_to_left, pool.seek_exit, all model-unit persons per year

name: O
label: Onboarding staff
description: New hires still ramping up before they count as productive headcount, by unit and level.
notes: in: hires; out: fl.onboard, both model-unit persons per year; spec gives persons; the engine's people stocks are in model units (catalogue H_, U lines)

name: Pipeline
label: Student pipeline
description: Students in IT programmes who have not yet graduated, by region.
notes: in: Enrol; out: Grad, both model-unit persons per year; graduates join the model-unit seeker pools

name: PUL
label: Student-perceived unemployment
description: The unemployment rate as prospective students perceive it, smoothed over the student perception time, which drives enrolment, by region.
notes: goal-seeking towards UnempRate; its flow flow:PUL is fraction per year

name: PUS
label: Worker-perceived unemployment
description: The unemployment rate as workers perceive it, smoothed over the unemployment perception time, which drives leaving the field and wages, by region.
notes: goal-seeking towards UnempRate; its flow flow:PUS is fraction per year

name: R
label: Recovering after layoff
description: Recently laid-off people recovering before they search for IT work again, by region and level.
notes: in: fl.layoffs (by POOL); out: pool.rec_to_seek, pool.rec_to_left, pool.rec_retire, all model-unit persons per year; spec gives persons; the engine's people stocks are in model units (catalogue H_, U lines)

name: Retired
label: Retired
description: A running total of people who have retired from IT employment or from the unemployed pools, by region.
notes: accumulator; in: fl.retire, pool.rec_retire, pool.seek_retire, all model-unit persons per year

name: U
label: Job seekers
description: Active IT job seekers in each regional labour pool, by region and level.
notes: in: fl.quits (by POOL), pool.rec_to_seek, Grad (J), ext, expiry (IN); out: hires, pool.seek_exit, pool.seek_retire, all model-unit persons per year; spec gives persons; the engine's people stocks are in model units (catalogue H_, U lines)

name: V
label: Vacancies
description: Open job slots waiting to be filled, by unit and level.
notes: in: fl.openings; out: cancel, promo, sw.in, hires, all model-unit persons per year; spec gives persons; the engine's people stocks are in model units (catalogue H_, U lines)

name: CostProg
label: Cost programme savings
description: The share of the vendor's labour cost saved by its cost programme, built up when its margin is below normal.

name: Disc
label: Competitive discount
description: The competitive discount the vendor gives on new signings, adjusting toward its target as it defends share or spends excess margin.

name: ECost
label: Expected delivery cost
description: The vendor's expected cost per unit of work relative to its base price, its cost index smoothed at the book's expiry rate, which the price floor reads.
notes: term: C5; same units as CostIdx; starts at the sentinel -1 and is filled with CostIdx on the first step

name: Leg
label: Legacy contracts
description: Contracts in force at the 2024 start, by vendor and type, with no inflow, running off over their base durations.
notes: hand-mapped (recon C2); build guide name Leg[Vendor, ContractType] (06b:80); spec 00 gives USD, but the build guides and the engine use a volume, each vendor's 2024 book summing to 1 (catalogue Book_ unit); its only flow VF.ExpLeg is book volume per year

name: NewD
label: Duration-weighted new book
description: The new contracts in force weighted by their terms, by vendor and type, a coflow whose ratio to new contract volume is their average term.
notes: unit addition (slice 10a): book volume-years because the coflow is book volume times years (spec 05:59 'share x yr') and the vocabulary has no product unit; flow:NewD is book volume-years per year: VB.Sign (book volume per year) enters with the factor Dnew (years) and the outflow term is NewV itself (book volume, dimensionally the same), so stock and flow agree

name: NewP
label: Price-weighted new book
description: The new contracts in force weighted by their price index, by vendor and type, a coflow whose ratio to new contract volume is their average price.
notes: book volume times a price index (2024 = 1), which is dimensionless, so it is in book volume (spec 05:60 'share x index'); VB.Sign enters with the factor PNew and VF.ExpNew leaves with the factor AvgP (both indexes), and the glide drains NewP x Glide (fraction per year), so every term is book volume per year

name: NewV
label: New contracts
description: Contracts signed since 2024, renewals included, still in force, by vendor and type.
notes: hand-mapped (recon C2); build guide name NewVol[ContractType] (05:58, 'share of total work', later the vendor book); flows VB.Sign in and VF.ExpNew out, both book volume per year

name: Overhead
label: Vendor overhead
description: The vendor's yearly overhead cost, adjusting slowly toward a set share of its revenue.
notes: a stock whose value is itself a rate (USD per year), so flow:Overhead is USD per year per year; catalogue unit inferred

name: ShareRef
label: Reference work share
description: The work share the vendor regards as normal, a slow average of its actual share, against which its share loss is measured.
notes: spec unit 'share of all work' (06b:78)

name: Viab
label: Vendor viability
description: The vendor's margin smoothed over ViabilityTime, the slow viability signal behind its discounts, cost programme, bargaining power and sourcing risk.
notes: hand-mapped (recon C2); build guide name Viability (04:56, fraction); the spec indexes it by employer, the engine by vendor; recorded as Vi_{vendor}

name: VMarg
label: Vendor margin signal
description: The vendor's margin smoothed over a short R6MargTime, starting from viability, whose ratio to normal margin is the relative viability that vendor stress terms read.
notes: term: R6; read by C2 (workforce) and C4 (sourcing) through Vrel = VMarg / NormalMargin; advanced for every model

name: WI
label: Wage index
description: Each unit's wage level relative to its base wage, adjusting slowly toward its target.
notes: catalogue unit index (2024 = 1); spec unit dimensionless, initial 1 for every unit; flow:WI is its only flow

name: C4Hab
label: Habituated viability shortfall
description: Each vendor's relative-viability shortfall below the R6 threshold, smoothed over the fade time: the part of the distress clients have grown used to.
notes: term: C4; a shortfall of relative viability (an index, 2024 = 1) below R6Theta, 0 in 2024, so dimensionless rather than an index; its flow flow:C4Hab is dimensionless per year

name: GCCW
label: GCC work share
description: The share of each sector's IT work held by global capability centres, the captive units of client firms.
notes: the GCC part of the spec's SourcingShare[Sector][Employer] (fraction); inflow Contested x SrcPerc[GCC] and outflow Contest x GCCTurn, both fraction per year

name: IHW
label: In-house work share
description: The share of each sector's IT work held by its own in-house teams.
notes: the in-house part of the spec's SourcingShare[Sector][Employer] (fraction); inflow Contested x SrcPerc[IH] and outflow Contest x IHTurn, both fraction per year

name: SrcPerc
label: Perceived sourcing shares
description: The perceived sourcing shares by sector and employer that allocate contested work, adjusting toward the sourcing targets with a delay.
notes: tilted toward GCC by GCCMomentum at the start of the run (S0); spec unit fraction; its flow flow:SrcPerc is fraction per year

name: VW
label: Vendor work share
description: The share of each sector's IT work held by each vendor under contract.
notes: the vendor part of the spec's SourcingShare[Sector][Employer] (fraction); inflow SignS and outflow VExp, both fraction per year

name: WS0
label: 2024 GCC work share
description: The economy-wide GCC share of completed IT work in 2024, the reference of loop R7, held at -1 until the first step fills it.
notes: term: R7; filled once on the first step, so it has no flow; the sentinel -1 is not a fraction

name: A
label: Delivery AI adoption
description: The share of each employer's delivery work that uses AI, rising by Bass diffusion from its 2024 level, by employer.
notes: spec name from the recon C2 stock mapping; its one flow AdoptE is in fraction per year

name: AC
label: Consumer AI adoption
description: The share of each sector's consumers that have adopted AI in their own business.

name: Att
label: AI seat attach rate
description: The share of seats with an AI add-on, across all sectors; it shares its name with the auxiliary `Att` and the output `Att`.

name: CostPerc
label: Perceived IT cost
description: Consumers' perceived cost per unit of IT work relative to 2024, following the services cost index with a delay.
notes: starts at 1 in 2024; read by Jev

name: LOB
label: LOB headcount
description: Line-of-business (non-IT) staff of each consumer sector; not the output `LOB`, the all-sector total.
notes: spec unit persons; catalogue model-unit persons used

name: Port
label: Application portfolio
description: The number of applications each consumer sector runs.
notes: unit addition (slice 10a): applications because the spec counts the portfolio in applications (06a stock table) and no vocabulary term fits

name: SeatsB
label: Billed seats
description: Software seats each sector is billed for, following actual seats at device refresh and licence renewal.
notes: unit addition (slice 10a): seats because the spec counts billed seats in seats (06a stock table) and SeatSpend prices them per seat a year

name: SpendRatio
label: Spend to budget ratio
description: Each sector's committed IT spend over its budget, smoothed over the budget cycle.
notes: spec lists fraction, but it is a ratio that can exceed 1 (Approval reads its excess over 1), so dimensionless

name: Aband
label: Work abandonment
description: IT work dropped each year, by sector and work type, where its holders' completion rates fall short of what clients tolerate.
notes: outflow of BL (BFY)

name: Comp
label: Work completion
description: IT work completed each year, by sector and work type, at the completion rates of the employers holding it.
notes: outflow of BL (BFY)

name: flow:ClientP
label: Client perception change
description: The yearly adjustment of client-perceived productivity toward each employer's actual productivity over ClientPerceptionTime.
notes: goal-seeking update of ClientP

name: flow:ClientPRef
label: Reference productivity change
description: The yearly adjustment of the client reference productivity toward client-perceived productivity over TrendTime.
notes: goal-seeking update of ClientPRef

name: flow:PerceivedP
label: Perception change
description: The yearly adjustment of each employer's perceived productivity toward its actual productivity over PerceptionTime.
notes: goal-seeking update of PerceivedP

name: cancel
label: Vacancy cancellations
description: Vacancies withdrawn each year because they exceed the shortfall, by unit and level, no faster than vacancies could be filled.
notes: leaves V at full weight; vacancies are slots counted in model-unit persons, as V

name: flow:TightPerc
label: Tightness perception adjustment
description: The yearly adjustment of perceived visa tightness toward the policy tightness, over the tightness perception time.

name: promo
label: Promotions
description: Staff promoted into mid and senior roles each year, filling vacancies from the level below, by unit and level.
notes: enters H at its own level and leaves V there as a fill, both at full weight; the level below loses it through fl.promo_out

name: conv
label: Visa conversions
description: Visa holders (OV) who convert to local onshore vendor staff (OL), at a rate reduced by visa tightness, by level.
notes: leaves H[OV] and enters H[OL]

name: Enrol
label: Enrolment
description: Students entering IT programmes each year, growing with demand and cut by poor job prospects, by region.
notes: enters Pipeline; spec 07:14 adds the growth factor G (written Enrol[r])

name: expiry
label: Visa expiries
description: Visa holders (OV) whose visas expire, leaving onshore employment for the India seeker pool, by level.
notes: leaves H[OV] and enters U[IN]

name: ext
label: External entry
description: Experienced people entering the seeker pool from outside IT when time to fill exceeds normal, by region and level; zero for juniors.
notes: enters U

name: fl.layoffs
label: Layoffs
description: Staff laid off to remove a staffing surplus net of attrition, no faster than the minimum layoff time allows, by unit and level.
notes: leaves H and enters R of the unit's labour pool

name: fl.leave
label: Leaving IT
description: Employed staff who leave the IT field altogether, by unit and level.
notes: leaves H and enters LeftField; a voluntary exit for R10

name: fl.onboard
label: Onboarding completions
description: New hires who finish onboarding and become productive headcount, by unit and level.
notes: leaves O and enters H

name: fl.openings
label: Vacancy openings
description: New vacancies opened to replace staff losses and close any staffing shortfall not already covered by open vacancies, by unit and level.
notes: with OpeningsContinuous on (1 in phase9) the shortfall formula applies for every surplus and tapers to 0; off, openings are 0 in surplus

name: fl.promo_out
label: Promotions out
description: Staff promoted out of their level into the next level up in the same unit, by unit and level; zero for seniors.
notes: equals the promotion flow into the level above

name: fl.quits
label: Quits
description: Staff who leave their employer voluntarily to seek another IT job, by unit and level.
notes: leaves H and enters the seeker pool U of the unit's labour pool; a voluntary exit for R10

name: fl.retire
label: Retirements
description: Senior staff who retire from employment, by unit; zero for juniors and mids.
notes: leaves H and enters Retired

name: flow:PUL
label: Long perception change
description: The yearly adjustment of perceived long-term unemployment towards the current unemployment rate, by region.
notes: goal-seeking update of PUL (fraction)

name: flow:PUS
label: Short perception change
description: The yearly adjustment of perceived short-term unemployment towards the current unemployment rate, by region.
notes: goal-seeking update of PUS (fraction)

name: Grad
label: Graduation
description: Students graduating from IT programmes into the junior seeker pool, by region.
notes: leaves Pipeline and enters U at level J

name: hires
label: Hires
description: Seekers hired into onboarding through the pool's matching of seekers and vacancies, capped by each unit's room and the visa cap, by unit and level.
notes: leaves V and U, enters O

name: pool.rec_retire
label: Recovering retirements
description: Senior recently laid-off people who retire, by region; zero for juniors and mids.
notes: leaves R and enters Retired

name: pool.rec_to_left
label: Recovered, left field
description: Recently laid-off people who leave the IT field after recovering, a share that rises with perceived unemployment, by region and level.
notes: leaves R and enters LeftField

name: pool.rec_to_seek
label: Recovered to seeking
description: Recently laid-off people who finish recovering and start seeking IT work, by region and level.
notes: leaves R and enters U

name: pool.seek_exit
label: Seeker exits
description: Job seekers who give up on IT and leave the field, scaled by the leave effect and, under R4, by spell length, by region and level.
notes: term: R4 (multiplier R4Mult applied, capped at U / MinSeekTime, only while R4a or R4aIN is nonzero); leaves U and enters LeftField

name: pool.seek_retire
label: Seeker retirements
description: Senior job seekers who retire, by region; zero for juniors and mids.
notes: leaves U and enters Retired

name: sw.in
label: Switches in
description: Staff joining a unit directly from another unit in the same labour pool, drawn by relative wages and vacancies, by unit and level.
notes: fills vacancies (V) and adds to H; OV never switches (SWITCHERS)

name: sw.out
label: Switches out
description: Staff leaving a unit directly for another unit in the same labour pool, the mirror of switches in, by unit and level.
notes: part of net loss for openings and layoffs; a voluntary exit for R10 (loops.vol_cell)

name: flow:CostProg
label: Cost programme adjustment
description: The yearly change in cost programme savings as they move toward their target over CostProgramTime.

name: flow:Disc
label: Discount adjustment
description: The yearly change in the competitive discount as it moves toward its target over DiscAdjTime.

name: flow:ECost
label: Expected cost adjustment
description: The yearly change in the vendor's expected delivery cost as it moves toward the current cost index at the book's expiry rate.
notes: term: C5; the gap (dimensionless) times ExpRate (fraction per year)

name: flow:NewD
label: Duration-weighted book change
description: The yearly change in the duration-weighted new book: signings times their terms, less the duration weight that expiring contracts take with them.
notes: unit addition (slice 10a): book volume-years (see NewD), so this is dimensionally book volume; reads NewV after its update in the same step (read-after-update)

name: flow:NewP
label: Price-weighted book change
description: The yearly change in the price-weighted new book: signings at their price, less expiries at the average price, less the price glide of contracts in force.

name: flow:Overhead
label: Overhead adjustment
description: The yearly change in vendor overhead as it closes the gap to its target share of revenue over OverheadAdjTime.
notes: the stock Overhead is itself USD per year

name: flow:ShareRef
label: Reference share adjustment
description: The yearly change in the reference work share as it follows the vendor's actual share over ShareRefTime.

name: flow:Viab
label: Viability adjustment
description: The yearly change in the viability index as it closes the gap to the current margin over ViabilityTime.

name: flow:VMarg
label: Margin signal adjustment
description: The yearly change in the vendor margin signal as it closes the gap to the current margin over R6MargTime.
notes: term: R6

name: flow:WI
label: Wage index adjustment
description: The yearly change in each unit's wage index as it moves toward its target over WageAdjTime.

name: VB.Sign
label: New signings
description: Contract volume the vendor signs each year, renewals plus wins, by contract type.
notes: inflow of NewV; enters NewD with the factor Dnew (years) and NewP with the factor PNew (an index); recorded as SignVol_{vendor}_{type}; not the sector signings Sign[Sector, Vendor] of spec 06b:170 (the code's SignS)

name: VF.ExpLeg
label: Legacy expiries
description: Legacy contracts in force since 2024 that expire each year, by vendor and type, running off over their base durations.
notes: the only flow of Leg (out)

name: VF.ExpNew
label: New contract expiries
description: New contracts that expire each year, by vendor and type, over their average term in force.
notes: outflow of NewV; leaves NewP with the factor AvgP (an index), so that term is also book volume per year

name: flow:C4Hab
label: Habituation adjustment
description: The yearly adjustment of each vendor's habituated shortfall toward its current relative-viability shortfall, over the C4 fade time.
notes: term: C4

name: flow:SrcPerc
label: Sourcing perception adjustment
description: The yearly adjustment of each perceived sourcing share toward its target, closing the gap over the sourcing perception time.
notes: skipped while FreezeSourcing is set

name: SignS
label: Vendor signings
description: The share of each sector's work signed by each vendor each year: its renewed expiring work plus its perceived share of contested work.
notes: hand-mapped to the spec's Sign; also read by the vendor signing rate in finance

name: Src.Contested
label: Contested work
description: The share of each sector's work put out to sourcing choice each year: the contested part of reviewed in-house and GCC work and of expiring vendor work.
notes: enters IHW and GCCW with the factor SrcPerc (a fraction) and VW through SignS, so each term is fraction per year

name: Src.GCCTurn
label: GCC work review
description: The share of each sector's work held by GCCs that comes up for sourcing review each year.
notes: leaves GCCW with the factor Contest (only its contested part leaves); GCCW is a fraction, so the term is fraction per year

name: Src.IHTurn
label: In-house work review
description: The share of each sector's work held in house that comes up for sourcing review each year.
notes: leaves IHW with the factor Contest (only its contested part leaves); IHW is a fraction, so the term is fraction per year

name: Src.VExp
label: Vendor work expiry
description: The share of each sector's work held by each vendor whose contracts expire each year.
notes: leaves VW at full weight; ExpRate is the vendor's book expiry rate per year

name: AdoptE
label: Adoption rate
description: The yearly increase in each employer's delivery AI adoption, a Bass diffusion rate scaled by the cost, brake and push effects; zero with AI off.
notes: flow into A (fraction); capped at closing the gap to 1 in MinAdoptionTime

name: AttAdopt
label: AI seat attach
description: The yearly rise in the share of seats with an AI add-on, by Bass diffusion; zero with AI off.

name: cons.AdoptC
label: Consumer AI adoption
description: The yearly rise in each sector's consumer AI adoption, by Bass diffusion slowed by regulatory drag and sped by cost and reinvested savings.
notes: loop R1 through reinvested savings; the adoption noise factor multiplies it

name: cons.NewApps
label: New applications
description: Applications each sector adds to its portfolio a year, cut as AI agents displace new apps.
notes: unit addition (slice 10a): applications per year because it flows into the application portfolio Port, counted in applications; loop B9

name: cons.Retire
label: Application retirements
description: Applications each sector retires a year, sped up by AI exposure; applications, not people retiring.
notes: unit addition (slice 10a): applications per year because it flows out of Port, counted in applications; not a workforce retirement flow; loop B9

name: Demand
label: IT work demand
description: New IT work arriving each year by sector and work type, flowing into the backlog; not the output `Demand`, which is total demand.
notes: loops R2 (AI build) and B9 (portfolio)

name: flow:CostPerc
label: Perceived cost adjustment
description: The yearly change in consumers' perceived IT cost as it follows the services cost index.

name: flow:LOB
label: LOB headcount adjustment
description: The yearly change in each sector's line-of-business headcount as it closes the gap to its target, mostly through attrition.

name: flow:SeatsB
label: Billed seat adjustment
description: The yearly change in each sector's billed seats as they close the gap to actual seats.
notes: unit addition (slice 10a): seats per year because it is the flow of the SeatsB stock (seats)

name: flow:SpendRatio
label: Spend ratio adjustment
description: The yearly change in each sector's smoothed spend to budget ratio as it follows committed spend over budget.

name: aW
label: Automatable share
description: The share of each work type that AI can automate, closing part of its gap to the ceiling each year from its 2024 level.
notes: re-anchored at the perturb year when a run's g differs from the base (Reanchor); spec module 7 calls it AutomatableShare[WorkType](t)

name: G
label: Demand growth multiplier
description: The underlying growth multiplier on base IT demand, budgets and graduate supply, 1 in 2024; shares its name with the output `G`, which records it.
notes: catalogue unit 'index' (2024 = 1) mapped to index (2024 = 1); demand noise multiplies it after the perturb year

name: PAI
label: AI-assisted productivity
description: The productivity of fully AI-assisted work on each work type relative to unassisted work, by Amdahl's law with verification overhead.
notes: the spec's productivity multiplier (module 7); capability noise multiplies it after the perturb year

name: PAI0
label: 2024 AI-assisted productivity
description: The productivity of fully AI-assisted work on each work type at 2024 capability, the reference that makes employer productivity 1 in 2024.

name: Pew
label: Employer work-type productivity
description: The productivity of each employer on each work type relative to 2024, blending AI-assisted and unassisted work by the employer's adoption; 1 with AI off.
notes: 1 in 2024 because the initial A equals A0 (0.35 in every shipped baseline)

name: VerifNow
label: Verification overhead
description: The current effort spent checking AI output per unit of automated work, falling as AI models become more reliable.
notes: same unit as Verif (spec: dimensionless); re-anchored at the perturb year when a run's VerifDecline differs from the base

name: BLe
label: Employer backlog
description: The IT work waiting that each employer holds, its work share of every sector's backlog.

name: BLs
label: Sector backlog
description: The total IT work waiting in each sector, over all work types.

name: CapE
label: Delivery capacity
description: The IT work each employer's effective staff could complete in a year at its current productivity.

name: CompE
label: Employer work completed
description: The IT work each employer completes a year, its capacity capped by clearing its backlog in MinCompletionTime.

name: Completion
label: Total work completed
description: Total IT work completed a year by all employers; shares its name with the output `Completion`, which records it.

name: CompS
label: Sector work completed
description: IT work completed a year in each sector, by all employers and work types.

name: CS
label: Sector completion share
description: Each sector's share of all completed IT work, or its base sector share when nothing completes.

name: EffE
label: Employer backlog effort
description: The effort each employer needs to clear its backlog, with each work type deflated by the employer's productivity on it.
notes: backlog in BFY divided by the index Pew, so BFY of effort at 2024 productivity

name: EffortDone
label: Effort spent
description: The total effort spent a year on completed work, each employer's completion deflated by its productivity.
notes: the denominator of P_all in the spec formula

name: EffStaffE
label: Effective staff
description: Each employer's level-weighted staff in mid-level equivalents, counting onboarding staff at reduced productivity.
notes: level-weighted: W_M = 1 is the unit of effective staff

name: EmpShare
label: Employer work share
description: Each employer's share of each sector's IT work, read from the in-house, GCC and vendor sourcing stocks, by sector and employer.
notes: catalogue unit 'share' (the Src_ rows) mapped to fraction

name: P_all
label: Realised productivity
description: Realised delivery productivity over all employers relative to 2024, completion over effort; shares its name with the output `P_all`, which records it.
notes: catalogue unit 'index' (1 in 2024) mapped to index (2024 = 1)

name: Pe
label: Employer productivity
description: Each employer's work-weighted delivery productivity relative to 2024, by employer; 1 when it holds no backlog.
notes: catalogue unit 'index' (relative to 2024) mapped to index (2024 = 1); feeds loop B1 through PerceivedP

name: RateE
label: Employer completion rate
description: The fraction of its held backlog that each employer completes per year, applied to every sector and work type it serves.
notes: completion (BFY per year) over backlog (BFY); at most 1 / MinCompletionTime, so it can exceed 1 a year

name: TotBL
label: Total backlog
description: Total IT work waiting, summed over all sectors and work types.
notes: recorded as the output Backlog

name: avail
label: Fill capacity
description: The vacancy fill capacity left after cancellations, by unit and level, which caps promotions, job switches and hires.
notes: a rate, not a flow

name: denomE
label: Effective staff per head
description: The average level weight per head of each employer's staff mix, which converts effective staff into heads.
notes: W_M = 1 is the unit of effective staff

name: Desired
label: Desired headcount
description: The headcount each unit wants at each level, its employer's desired effective staff split by unit share and level mix.

name: DesiredE
label: Desired effective staff
description: The effective staff each employer wants, enough to clear its backlog within the target clearance time at perceived productivity.
notes: term: C2 (a vendor's value is cut by loops.cut when R6e is not 0); in effective, level-weighted staff (W_M = 1)

name: dTight
label: Tightness gap
description: Perceived visa tightness above its 2024 level, which drives OIT's offshore shift and local hiring.
notes: on the 0-1 visa tightness scale (0 open, 1 closed; 0.3 in 2024), which is not 1 in 2024, so dimensionless

name: OnsiteShare
label: OIT onsite share
description: The share of OIT's work done onsite, falling as perceived visa tightness rises above its 2024 level.

name: ShareL
label: Level mix
description: The share of each employer's staff at each level, with the junior share cut as delivery AI adoption rises above its 2024 level.
notes: the junior share is floored at 5% of Share0_J, with no cut while AI is off

name: surplus
label: Staff surplus
description: Staff in post plus onboarding minus desired headcount, by unit and level; negative when short.

name: UnitIn
label: Unit work share
description: Each model unit's share of its employer's work, splitting OIT into offshore, onsite visa and onsite local units and GSI into India and onshore.
notes: 1 for IH, GCC and BQ

name: VisaMix
label: Onsite visa mix
description: The share of OIT's onsite roles staffed by visa holders, falling as perceived visa tightness rises.

name: VisaTight
label: Visa tightness
description: The visa policy tightness from 0 open to 1 closed, ramping from VTBase to VTEnd; shares its name with the output `VisaTight`, which records it.
notes: catalogue unit 'index' mapped to dimensionless: on the 0-1 visa tightness scale (0 open, 1 closed; 0.3 in 2024), which is not 1 in 2024, so dimensionless

name: EnrolEffect
label: Enrolment effect
description: A multiplier on enrolment that falls as perceived long-term unemployment rises above its normal rate, held within 0.4-1.3, by region.
notes: closes loop B5 (discouraged entry) through Enrol

name: LeaveEffect
label: Leave effect
description: A multiplier on leaving the field and on seeker exits, rising with perceived short-term unemployment over its normal rate, held within 0.5-3, by region.
notes: scales the leave fraction of the recovering and the seeker exit

name: R4Mult
label: Skill erosion multiplier
description: The R4 skill-erosion multiplier on seeker exits, rising with the expected spell length relative to 2024, by region and level; 1 while R4 is off.
notes: term: R4; read by pool.seek_exit; catalogue unit 'ratio (1 at 2024)' mapped to index (2024 = 1); a multiplier in use, but 1 at 2024 by construction (Dur0 is the first step's spell length)

name: TTFr
label: Time to fill
description: The time to fill vacancies in each regional labour pool, by level: pool vacancies over their yearly fills, with fills floored at one a year.

name: TTFratio
label: Mid time-to-fill ratio
description: The mid-level time to fill of each regional labour pool over its normal value, a capacity-strain signal for sourcing and contract choice.
notes: near 1 in 2024 through the calibrated NormalTTF (a level_2024 parameter), not 1 by construction

name: UnempRate
label: IT unemployment rate
description: The IT unemployment rate of each regional labour pool: recovering and seeking people over the pool's employed, onboarding, recovering and seeking people.
notes: OV staff count in the India pool (POOL); catalogue unit 'fraction' (inferred) agrees

name: VisaCap
label: Visa cap
description: The most visa-holder (OV) hires allowed a year across all levels: the base cap reduced by visa tightness.
notes: caps model-unit OV hires (spec 03:215 gives the base cap in persons/yr); scaled by G only while Burn is on

name: AICostCons
label: Consumer AI cost
description: Yearly cost of AI tooling on the work that in-house teams and GCCs deliver with AI, a part of consumer IT services spend.
notes: an unnamed term of the spec's ServicesSpend formula; AICostPerUnit (USD per BFY) x delivered work (BFY per year)

name: AICostPerUnit
label: AI cost per unit
description: Cost in real US dollars of one unit of work performed by AI, falling each year from its 2024 level and raised during a compute shock.
notes: re-anchored at the perturb year when AICostDecline differs from the base (Reanchor); the noise factor aicost multiplies it

name: AIShockNow
label: AI cost shock factor
description: The factor on AI cost per unit of work from a compute shock: AIShockMult inside the shock window and 1 outside it.
notes: also multiplies the consumer credit cost CreditCostPB (consumer)

name: capu
label: Unit effective staff
description: Level-weighted staff of each employment unit, with onboarding staff at reduced productivity, used to split the employer's completed work across its units.
notes: by unit; the level weights W make it mid-level-equivalent staff (W_M = 1 is the unit of effective staff, domains.csv W_M)

name: Delivered
label: Work delivered
description: Work each employment unit delivers in a year, its employer's completed work split across the employer's units by effective staff.
notes: recorded as Del_{unit}

name: LabourCost
label: Unit labour cost
description: Yearly labour cost of each employment unit, the pay of its employed and onboarding staff, in real US dollars.
notes: recorded as LabCost_{unit}

name: Pass
label: Gain pass-through share
description: The share of in-term AI productivity gains each contract type passes to the client: none for fixed price, all for effort-billed types, set shares for managed services and outcome-based.
notes: by contract type

name: RevenueTot
label: Total vendor revenue
description: Total yearly revenue of the three vendors in real US dollars; shares its name with the output `RevenueTot`, which records this value.
notes: the spec writes it as the sum of Revenue[v] (06b:150) without a name

name: ServicesSpend
label: Services spend
description: Consumers' yearly IT services spend: in-house and GCC labour, GCC overhead, vendor revenue and own AI cost; shares its name with the output `ServicesSpend`.

name: VB.Afford
label: Discount affordability
description: How far the vendor can afford to defend its share with price: its viability over its normal margin, kept between 0 and 1.
notes: scales the share-loss term of DiscTarget

name: VB.CostIdx
label: Vendor cost index
description: The vendor's cost per unit of work relative to its base price per unit, which sets contract profits and, smoothed, the expected cost under the price floor.
notes: USD per BFY over USD per BFY; about 1 - Margin in 2024, not 1; read by the type-choice profit and by ECost (C5); not the consumer CostIdx of spec 06a:130

name: VB.CostProgTarget
label: Cost programme target
description: The share of labour cost the vendor's cost programme aims to save when its margin is below normal, capped at MaxSavings.

name: VB.DiscTarget
label: Target discount
description: The competitive discount on new signings the vendor moves toward, set by share loss it can afford to fight and by margin above normal.
notes: capped at MaxDisc

name: VB.EffortShare
label: Effort-billed share
description: The share of the vendor's contract book billed by effort, time and materials plus staff augmentation, which brakes the vendor's AI adoption.
notes: catalogue unit 'share' mapped to fraction

name: VB.Margin
label: Vendor margin
description: The vendor's profit margin, revenue less total cost over revenue, the signal its viability index smooths.
notes: can be negative; feeds Viab and VMarg

name: VB.SalesCost
label: Sales cost
description: The vendor's yearly cost of winning and renewing contracts, in proportion to its revenue and its signing rate.
notes: catalogue unit inferred; holds with SalesCostRate in years (USD per year x per year x SalesCostRate)

name: VB.ShareLoss
label: Share loss
description: How far the vendor's work share has fallen below its reference share, relative to that reference, zero when at or above it.
notes: catalogue unit inferred

name: VB.SignRate
label: Signing rate
description: The share of the vendor's contract book signed each year, renewals plus wins, taken from its signings across sectors.
notes: catalogue unit 'rate (per year)' (inferred) mapped to fraction per year; falls back to ExpRate when the vendor has no work

name: VB.TypeShare
label: Signing type share
description: The share of the vendor's new signings that goes to each contract type, from a logit over client and vendor utilities.
notes: catalogue unit 'share' mapped to fraction; recorded as Sign_{vendor}_{type}

name: VB.VendorCost
label: Vendor total cost
description: The vendor's total yearly cost: net labour, visa, AI tooling, overhead and sales costs, plus the attrition cost when that loop is on.
notes: term: R10 (adds R10rc x wage x excess voluntary exits, USD a year, when R10rc is not 0; loops.r10cost)

name: VB.VolAttr
label: Voluntary attrition ratio
description: The vendor's voluntary exits per head, from quits, leaving the field and switch-outs, relative to their 2024 value.
notes: term: R10 (its signal; the R10 cost reads the same ratio in loops.r10cost); catalogue unit 'ratio (1 at 2024)' mapped to index (2024 = 1); recorded as VoluntaryAttrition_{vendor} for every model

name: VB.VShare
label: Vendor work share
description: The vendor's share of all completed IT work across sectors.
notes: catalogue unit 'share' mapped to fraction; equals WorkShare_{vendor}

name: VB.wv
label: Vendor bargaining weight
description: The weight of the vendor's profit, against the client's utility, in the contract-type choice, rising with bargaining power and kept between 0.1 and 0.9.
notes: the client weight is 1 - wv

name: VF.AICost
label: Vendor AI cost
description: The vendor's yearly cost of AI tooling on the share of its delivered work that AI performs.

name: VF.Anchor
label: Client price anchor
description: The price clients expect per unit of work for priced contracts after AI gains, relative to 2024, set by their perceived productivity and its trend.
notes: term: C6 (the AI-discount ceiling holds it at or above 1 - AIDiscCeil, after the noise, when AIDiscCeil is not 0); 1 in 2024 since ClientP = ClientPRef = 1 and the noise factor is 1 up to Y; read by PNew and the vendor sourcing cost

name: VF.AvgDur
label: Average new duration
description: The average term of the new contracts in force, by vendor and type, falling back to the current signing term while there are none.
notes: NewD / NewV; sets ExpNew

name: VF.AvgIdx
label: Book price index
description: The average price of the vendor's in-force contract book relative to 2024, with effort-billed contracts deflated by productivity.
notes: catalogue unit 'index' with '2024 = 1' in its description mapped to index (2024 = 1)

name: VF.AvgP
label: Average new price
description: The average price index of the new contracts in force, by vendor and type, falling back to the current signing price while there are none.
notes: NewP / NewV; expiring contracts take it out of NewP (ExpNew x AvgP); 1 in 2024 since NewV starts at 0 and PNew is 1

name: VF.BasePriceAvg
label: Average base price
description: The vendor's average base price per unit of work, its units' prices weighted by their shares of its work.
notes: read by the vendor sourcing cost (sourcing CostOpt)

name: VF.BaseRev
label: Base revenue
description: The vendor's yearly revenue at base unit prices, before the book's price index and any price shock.
notes: catalogue unit inferred; Price_ is USD per unit of work (domains.csv Price_)

name: VF.Book
label: Contract book
description: The vendor's whole contract book in force, legacy plus new contracts of every type, normalised so each vendor's 2024 book is 1.
notes: catalogue unit 'book volume (vendor 2024 book = 1)' (Book_{vendor}_{type}, its parts by type) mapped to book volume

name: VF.CeilBinds
label: Discount ceiling binds
description: Marks a step where the AI-discount ceiling raises the vendor's client price anchor: 1 when it binds, 0 otherwise or while the ceiling is off.
notes: term: C6; recorded as AIDiscCeilBinds_{vendor}

name: VF.dev
label: Margin deviation
description: How far the vendor's viability index sits above or below its normal margin, as a signed share of revenue.
notes: signed (negative below normal); 0 in 2024 since NormalMargin equals the initial Viab; drives Power

name: VF.DevEff
label: Effective margin deviation
description: The vendor's margin deviation beyond a deadband around normal, zero inside it, which drives discounts, cost programmes, wage restraint and sourcing risk.
notes: signed (negative below normal)

name: VF.Disc
label: Competitive discount
description: The vendor's competitive discount on new signings, as read from the stock `Disc` for this step.
notes: a copy of the stock Disc; read by the vendor sourcing cost

name: VF.Dnew
label: New contract duration
description: The term of contracts signed now, by vendor and type, shortened by expected price declines, lengthened by bargaining power and floored at MinDur.
notes: enters NewD as Sign x Dnew

name: VF.ExpRate
label: Book expiry rate
description: The share of the vendor's contract book that expires each year, legacy and new contracts together.
notes: catalogue unit 'rate (per year)' (inferred) mapped to fraction per year; also the fallback SignRate and the smoothing rate of ECost (C5)

name: VF.FloorBinds
label: Price floor binds
description: Marks, by vendor and contract type, a step where the price floor raises the new-signing price: 1 when it binds, 0 otherwise or while the floor is off.
notes: term: C5; recorded as PriceFloorBinds_{vendor}_{type}

name: VF.Glide
label: Price glide rate
description: The yearly rate at which the in-force price of managed-services and outcome-based contracts falls as their share of productivity gains passes to clients, zero for other types.
notes: drains NewP at NewP x Glide

name: VF.IdxVol
label: Price-weighted book
description: The vendor's contract book weighted by price, by type, with effort-billed types deflated by productivity; its total over the book is the book's price index.
notes: book volume times a price index (2024 = 1), which is dimensionless, so it stays in book volume; summed into AvgIdx

name: VF.LabRaw
label: Gross vendor labour cost
description: The vendor's yearly labour cost over its units before the savings of its cost programme.

name: VF.nm
label: Normal margin
description: The vendor's normal margin, the parameter `NormalMargin` for that vendor, against which its viability and contract profits are judged.
notes: a copy of the parameter NormalMargin_{vendor}, which equals the initial Viab (calibration identity)

name: VF.PNew
label: New-signing price
description: The price of contracts signed now per unit of book volume, by vendor and type, relative to 2024, after the competitive discount and any price floor.
notes: term: C5 (the price floor raises it to at least PriceFloor x ECost, x Pe for effort types, when PriceFloor is not 0); catalogue unit 'index' with '2024 = 1' in its description mapped to index (2024 = 1): 1 in 2024 since Anchor = 1, Disc = 0 and the floor waits for ECost; for the effort types (TM, SA) it is a rate that revenue divides by Pe

name: VF.Power
label: Bargaining power
description: The vendor's bargaining power with clients, 1 at normal margin, rising with margin above normal and kept between PowerMin and PowerMax.
notes: catalogue unit 'index' (inferred) mapped to index (2024 = 1): 1 in 2024 because NormalMargin equals the initial Viab (a validated calibration identity); weights the vendor in type choice and lengthens new contracts

name: VF.PU
label: Price uncertainty
description: The yearly fall in cost per unit of work that clients expect from the trend in their perceived productivity of the vendor.
notes: catalogue unit 'rate (per year)' mapped to fraction per year; 0 in 2024

name: VF.Revenue
label: Vendor revenue
description: The vendor's yearly revenue in real US dollars from the work it delivers, at the prices in its contract book, less any price shock.

name: VF.shock
label: Price shock
description: The share of the vendor's revenue lost to a one-off price shock from PriceShockYear on, zero before it.
notes: also lowers the vendor's sourcing cost as clients see it (sourcing CostOpt)

name: VF.VendDel
label: Vendor work delivered
description: Work the vendor delivers in a year, summed over its employment units.

name: VF.Vi
label: Vendor viability
description: The vendor's viability index, its margin smoothed over ViabilityTime, as read from the stock `Viab` for this step.
notes: a copy of the stock Viab; recorded as Vi_{vendor}; read by Afford and the vendor sourcing risk

name: VF.VisaCost
label: Visa cost
description: The vendor's yearly visa fees on onsite visa hires plus compliance cost on onsite visa staff, nonzero only for OIT.
notes: catalogue unit inferred; the fee is USD per OV hire and the compliance cost USD per OV head a year (domains.csv)

name: VF.VLab
label: Net vendor labour cost
description: The vendor's yearly labour cost over its units, net of the savings of its cost programme.

name: Wage
label: Annual pay rate
description: Yearly pay per person by unit and level in real US dollars; shares its name with the parameter family `Wage`, the relative wage used in job switching.
units: USD per model-unit person per year
notes: hand-mapped: spec 04:83 names the dollar pay PayRate and keeps Wage for the relative-wage parameter (labour_market); BaseWage_ is USD a year per person (domains.csv); per model-unit person because LabourCost charges it on H + O

name: WITarget
label: Wage index target
description: The wage index each unit's wages move toward, rising with labour-market tightness and, for vendors below normal margin, held down by wage restraint.
notes: same units as WI, its goal; 1 in 2024 since NormalUnempRate equals the initial PUS (calibration identity) and DevEff is 0, and 1 when WagesEndogenous is off; the spec's Restraint[Unit] is inlined

name: AvgW
label: Average level weight
description: The average level weight per head of the in-house and GCC options, their effective staff per head from the current level mix.
notes: IH and GCC only; the same formula as denomE; W_M = 1 is the unit of effective staff

name: AvgWM
label: Average wage multiplier
description: The headcount-weighted average level wage multiplier of the in-house and GCC options, from their current level mix.
notes: IH and GCC only

name: ClientFlight
label: Client flight
description: The sourcing value each vendor loses to client flight while its relative viability is below the R6 threshold, net of habituation and capped; zero while kViab is 0.
notes: term: C4; subtracted from RiskOpt only when kViab is not 0, but recorded for every model

name: CostOpt
label: Sourcing option cost
description: The cost per unit of work of each sourcing option as clients see it, from wages and AI cost for in-house and GCC and from prices for vendors.
notes: catalogue unit 'USD per BFY' (inferred) agrees with the code: wage (USD a year) over effective staff per head and productivity, and it is divided by CostRef (USD/BFY)

name: GCCScaleTerm
label: GCC scale learning
description: The R7 term added to every sector's GCC sourcing value, rising with the economy-wide GCC work share over 2024; shares its name with the output `GCCScaleTerm`.
notes: term: R7; 0 while kR7 is 0 and on step 0

name: RiskOpt
label: Sourcing option risk
description: The risk term of each sourcing option's value: vendor viability and exit risk, OIT visa risk and, under loop R6, client flight; zero for in-house and GCC.
notes: term: C4 (ClientFlight subtracted when kViab is not 0); the spec's VendRisk covers vendors only, IH and GCC are 0; added to Val

name: SrcTarget
label: Sourcing target share
description: The target share of each sector's contested work for each employer, the logit choice over the sourcing values, toward which perceived shares move.
notes: catalogue unit 'share' mapped to fraction

name: Val
label: Sourcing value
description: The value (logit) of each employer option in each sector, from its constant, cost, risk, capacity and regulatory fit, plus appeal and scale terms for GCC.
notes: term: R7 (GCCScaleTerm added to the GCC value when kR7 is not 0)

name: Vrel
label: Relative viability
description: Each vendor's margin smoothed over 0.75 years relative to its normal margin, 1 in 2024 and the signal of the R6 capacity exit and client flight.
notes: term: C2, C4 (signal); read by C2 (workforce) and C4 (sourcing) through loops.vrel; catalogue unit 'ratio (1 at 2024)' mapped to index (2024 = 1)

name: brake
label: T&M adoption brake
description: The multiplier that slows a vendor's AI adoption in proportion to the effort-billed share of its contract book; 1 for in-house and GCC.
notes: loop B2 (T&M paradox)

name: CEe
label: Adoption cost effect
description: The multiplier on each employer's adoption speed from its labour cost and the AI cost, both relative to 2024, bounded by CEMin and CEMax.
notes: loop R5 (shortage accelerates AI)

name: labpb
label: Labour cost per capacity
description: Each employer's labour cost per unit of effective staff capacity, the dearer-labour signal that speeds its delivery AI adoption.
units: USD per model-unit person per year
notes: LabourCost is USD a year over effective staff, each worth WorkPerPerson = 1 BFY a year at baseline, so USD per BFY as in the spec and catalogue; loop R5; unit as the slice 10a catalogue fix (decision 6): labour cost per effective person-year, equal to USD per BFY only while WorkPerPerson and Pe are 1

name: push
label: Share-loss adoption push
description: The multiplier that speeds a vendor's AI adoption when it is losing work share; 1 for in-house and GCC.

name: Att
label: AI seat attach rate
description: The step's copy of the share of seats with an AI add-on; it shares its name with the stock `Att` and the output `Att`.

name: BudgetGrowth
label: Budget growth factor
description: The factor that grows each sector's 2024 IT budget with the economy and IT budget growth, less any budget shock.
notes: includes G and the budget noise factor, so it is not 1 in 2024 by construction

name: CEc
label: Consumer cost effect
description: The factor by which AI credit cost below or above its 2024 level speeds or slows consumer AI adoption, bounded by CEMin and CEMax.

name: CloudPB
label: Cloud spend per unit
description: Consumer cloud spend per unit of completed IT work, rising as AI does more of the work.
notes: the engine uses P_all in place of the spec's P_eff (06b)

name: cons.AgentWork
label: Agent work
description: The line-of-business work done by AI agents in each sector a year, equal to the LOB headcount automated away.
notes: a headcount difference read as person-years of work a year (one BFY is one person-year); times CreditCostPB (USD per BFY) it gives CreditSpend in USD per year

name: cons.AIBuild
label: AI build demand
description: Each sector's yearly IT work demand for building and running AI, from consumer adoption above its 2024 pace.
notes: the engine stores the spec's AIBuild share times base demand; no other item reads the stored value (Demand uses the share)

name: cons.Approval
label: Demand approval
description: The share of each sector's app, data and AI build demand approved, falling once smoothed committed spend exceeds the budget (loop B11).
notes: bounded between MinApproval and 1; applied as a factor on demand

name: cons.Budget
label: Consumer IT budget
description: Each sector's yearly IT budget: its grown 2024 budget plus a share of positive net LOB savings reinvested.
notes: the spec lists Budget0 in USD million a year; the baseline holds it in USD (catalogue USD per year)

name: cons.CloudSpend
label: Cloud spend
description: Each sector's yearly consumer cloud spend on the IT work it completes.

name: cons.Committed
label: Committed IT spend
description: Each sector's yearly committed IT spend: its share of services spend plus seats, AI credits and cloud.

name: cons.CreditSpend
label: AI credit spend
description: Each sector's yearly spend on AI credits for the agent work that replaces line-of-business staff.

name: cons.LOBTarget
label: LOB headcount target
description: The line-of-business headcount each sector would keep once AI exposure above 2024 has automated part of its work.
notes: units follow the LOB stock it is the goal of

name: cons.NetSavings
label: Net LOB savings
description: Each sector's yearly line-of-business wage bill saved by AI, less what it spends on AI credits.
notes: read by AdoptC (loop R1) and Budget

name: cons.RegDrag
label: Regulatory drag
description: The cut in each sector's consumer AI adoption speed from regulation, capped at 0.95; it also adds governance work and weighs on sourcing.

name: cons.Seats
label: Actual seats
description: Each sector's seats in use: its line-of-business staff plus its share of consumer IT staff.
notes: unit addition (slice 10a): seats because it is the goal of the SeatsB stock (seats); one seat per person, and spec 00 calls it persons; the Burn switch divides the IT part by G in calibration

name: cons.SeatSpend
label: Seat spend
description: Each sector's yearly spend on billed seats, at the base seat price plus the AI add-on price on attached seats.

name: ConsIT
label: Consumer IT headcount
description: In-house and GCC IT staff, all levels, the consumers' own IT headcount, sharing its name with the output `ConsIT`.
notes: excludes onboarding staff

name: CostIdx6
label: Services cost index
description: Consumers' current services spend per unit of completed IT work, relative to its 2024 level.
notes: 1 in 2024 through the calibrated CostPerBFY0; the spec's CostIdx

name: CreditCostPB
label: AI credit cost
description: The AI credit cost of one baseline FTE-year of agent work, falling with AI cost decline and scaled by any AI cost shock.
notes: re-anchored at the perturb year in two-phase runs when AICostDecline differs from the base

name: CyberMult
label: Cyber demand multiplier
description: The factor on security work demand, ramping from 1 at CyberStart to CyberEnd at CyberRampEnd.

name: DemandTot
label: Total IT demand
description: Total new IT work demand a year, summed over all sectors and work types.
notes: recorded as the output Demand

name: GCCAppeal
label: GCC appeal
description: The time-driven pull towards GCCs in sourcing, ramping up to GCCAppealEnd then fading to GCCAppealKeep of it.
notes: computed in the consumer drivers (S13a), so module consumer; read only by sourcing, as a term of the GCC sourcing value (spec Phase 5)

name: Jev
label: Jevons demand multiplier
description: The factor by which a fall in perceived IT cost raises app and data demand and AI build demand, capped at JevonsCap (loop R3).

name: LOBAuto
label: LOB automatable share
description: The share of line-of-business work that AI can do, rising from its 2024 level towards a ceiling.
notes: re-anchored at the perturb year in two-phase runs when aL_max or g differs from the base

name: RegRamp
label: Regulation phase-in
description: How far regulation has phased in, rising from 0 at RegStart to 1 at RegEnd.

name: A0
label: 2024 delivery adoption
description: Delivery AI adoption in 2024, the reference level against which employer productivity and the junior hiring share are measured.
notes: flagged level_2024; should equal the initial A stock; also read by workforce (level mix)

name: DemandGrowth
label: Demand growth rate
description: The underlying yearly growth rate of IT demand, budgets and graduate supply until LateYear, about 3% real.
notes: a proportional change a year (spec unit '-'), may be negative above -1; an anchored rate: may not differ from the baseline when perturb_from is after 2024

name: DemandGrowthLate
label: Late demand growth rate
description: The underlying yearly growth rate of IT demand after LateYear; empty means the same as DemandGrowth.
notes: nullable (None means DemandGrowth); lever; may be negative above -1

name: g
label: Capability growth rate
description: The fraction of the remaining gap between each work type's automatable share and its ceiling that AI capability closes each year.
notes: spec unit 1/yr; lever; also read by consumer LOB automation

name: LateYear
label: Late growth switch year
description: The calendar year at which underlying demand growth switches from DemandGrowth to DemandGrowthLate.

name: Verif
label: Initial verification overhead
description: The 2024 effort spent checking AI output per unit of automated work, which then falls at VerifDecline a year.
notes: fitted; flagged level_2024; lever

name: VerifDecline
label: Verification decline rate
description: The fraction of the verification overhead that disappears each year as AI models become more reliable.
notes: lever

name: AbandonTime
label: Abandonment time
description: The time over which work beyond the tolerated backlog is abandoned.

name: AbandonTolerance
label: Abandonment tolerance
description: The backlog clients tolerate, in years of throughput, before excess work starts to be abandoned.

name: ClientPerceptionTime
label: Client perception time
description: The time clients take to notice changes in their supplier's productivity.

name: MinCompletionTime
label: Minimum completion time
description: The shortest time in which any backlog can be cleared, which caps each employer's completion.

name: OnboardProductivity
label: Onboarding productivity
description: The output of onboarding staff relative to fully productive staff.
notes: also read by finance (unit capacity)

name: PerceptionTime
label: Perception time
description: The time employers take to recognise a change in their productivity, the lag in perceived productivity.

name: TrendTime
label: Trend time
description: The window over which client-perceived productivity is smoothed to measure its trend.
notes: also divides the productivity trend in finance

name: W
label: Level weight
description: The output of a junior, mid-level or senior person relative to a mid-level person, by level.
notes: W_M = 1 is the unit of effective staff; also read by workforce, finance and sourcing

name: WorkPerPerson
label: Work per person
description: The IT work one effective person completes a year at baseline productivity.
units: BFY per model-unit person per year
notes: spec unit BFY/person/yr; also in the desired headcount divisor (workforce)

name: CancelTime
label: Vacancy cancel time
description: The time employers take to withdraw unneeded vacancies.

name: GSIOffshore
label: GSI offshore share
description: The share of global systems integrator work delivered from India, the rest onshore.

name: JuniorCut
label: Junior hiring cut
description: The cut in the junior share of staff per unit of delivery AI adoption above its 2024 level.
notes: fitted in every shipped model; spec unit fraction (the share of junior roles AI removes at full adoption)

name: MinFillTime
label: Minimum fill time
description: The fastest a vacancy can be filled, which caps cancellations, promotions and hires; it equals the time step.

name: OffshoreShiftSens
label: Offshore shift sensitivity
description: How strongly OIT's onsite work moves offshore as perceived visa tightness rises.

name: OnsiteShare0
label: Base onsite share
description: The share of OIT's work done onsite at 2024 visa tightness.

name: PromoFillTime
label: Promotion fill time
description: How fast internal candidates fill vacancies at the mid and senior levels.

name: R6Cap
label: Capacity exit cap
description: The largest fraction of a vendor's desired staff that loop C2 can cut.
notes: term: C2; a shape parameter, inert while R6e is 0

name: R6e
label: Capacity exit strength
description: The strength of loop C2: the fraction of a vendor's desired staff cut per margin point of relative-viability shortfall below the R6 threshold.
notes: term: C2; unit addition (slice 10a): margin point because the cut is per percentage point of margin below the threshold (shortfall x NormalMargin x 100); 0 is off, 0.005 in phase9

name: Share0
label: Base level mix
description: The level mix of staff without AI: the 2024 junior, mid and senior shares.

name: TargetClearanceTime
label: Target clearance time
description: The time in which employers aim to clear their backlog, which sets their desired staff.

name: TightPerceptionTime
label: Tightness perception time
description: How long firms take to respond to a change in visa policy tightness.

name: TimeInJunior
label: Time as junior
description: The time until a junior is eligible for promotion to mid level.

name: TimeInMid
label: Time as mid
description: The time until a mid-level employee is eligible for promotion to senior.

name: VisaMix0
label: Base visa mix
description: The share of OIT's onsite roles staffed by visa holders at 2024 visa tightness.

name: VisaMixSens
label: Visa mix sensitivity
description: How strongly OIT switches onsite roles from visa holders to local hires as perceived visa tightness rises.

name: VTBase
label: Base visa tightness
description: Visa tightness in 2024 and before the ramp, on a scale from 0 open to 1 closed.
notes: spec unit 'index 0-1'; on the 0-1 visa tightness scale (0 open, 1 closed; 0.3 in 2024), which is not 1 in 2024, so dimensionless

name: VTEnd
label: End visa tightness
description: Visa tightness after the ramp, on a scale from 0 open to 1 closed: the visa policy scenario lever.
notes: spec unit 'index 0-1'; on the 0-1 visa tightness scale (0 open, 1 closed; 0.3 in 2024), which is not 1 in 2024, so dimensionless

name: VTRampEnd
label: Visa ramp end
description: The calendar year in which the visa tightness ramp ends.

name: VTRampStart
label: Visa ramp start
description: The calendar year in which the visa tightness ramp starts.

name: alpha
label: Matching seeker weight
description: The weight of seekers versus vacancies in the matching function, its exponent on seekers.
notes: a Cobb-Douglas exponent, so dimensionless rather than weight (spec 02:158 also says dimensionless)

name: BaseEnrolment
label: Base enrolment
description: Students entering IT programmes a year at normal job prospects and 2024 demand, by region.
notes: spec 03:194 gives persons/yr; it feeds the model-unit seeker pools through Pipeline, so model-unit persons per year

name: BaseLeaveFrac
label: Base leave fraction
description: The share of recovering laid-off people who leave the IT field at normal job prospects, by level.
notes: scaled by LeaveEffect and capped at 0.9

name: BaseVisaCap
label: Base visa cap
description: The visa-holder hires available a year at zero visa tightness.
notes: spec 03:215 gives persons/yr; it caps model-unit OV hires, so model-unit persons per year

name: Burn
label: Burn-in switch
description: A calibration-only switch that, when on, grows the visa cap and the IT part of seats with demand growth during the burn-in.
notes: 0 in every normal run; also read by consumer (seats)

name: ConvRate
label: Visa conversion rate
description: The yearly fraction of visa holders who convert to permanent residence and local staff at zero visa tightness.

name: EnrolSensitivity
label: Enrolment sensitivity
description: The sensitivity of enrolment to perceived long-term unemployment above its normal rate.

name: ExtEntryMax
label: External entry cap
description: The cap on the excess time-to-fill ratio that drives experienced external entry.

name: ExtEntryRate
label: External entry rate
description: The yearly rate of experienced entry from outside IT, as a share of pool headcount per unit of excess time to fill, for mid and senior levels.
notes: no junior member

name: HireAdjTime
label: Hiring adjustment time
description: The time over which employers open vacancies to close a staffing shortfall.

name: LayoffAdjTime
label: Layoff adjustment time
description: The time over which employers close a staffing surplus through layoffs.

name: LeaveITRate
label: Leave-IT rate
description: The yearly fraction of each level's headcount that leaves the IT field altogether.

name: m
label: Matching efficiency
description: The efficiency of matching job seekers to vacancies in each labour pool, where recruiters and AI screening act.
notes: spec 02:157 gives 1/yr; matches m x U^alpha x V^(1 - alpha) are model-unit persons a year, so m is a pure rate a year; not fraction per year, as its base value is 4

name: MinLayoffTime
label: Minimum layoff time
description: The shortest time in which a unit's whole headcount could be laid off, which caps the layoff rate.

name: MinSeekTime
label: Minimum seek time
description: The shortest time in which the seeker pool could empty through exits, which caps the seeker exit rate while skill erosion is on.
notes: term: R4; shape parameter, inert while R4a and R4aIN are 0

name: NormalTTF
label: Normal time to fill
description: The calibrated steady-state time to fill of each regional pool for mid and senior levels, the reference for external entry and the time-to-fill ratio.
notes: flagged level_2024 in domains.csv; no junior member

name: NormalUnempRate
label: Normal unemployment rate
description: The calibrated steady-state IT unemployment rate of each region, the reference for the leave and enrolment effects and for wages.

name: OnboardTime
label: Onboarding time
description: The time new hires take to ramp up before they count as productive headcount.

name: OpeningsContinuous
label: Continuous openings switch
description: An extension switch that, when on, lets openings taper smoothly to zero as overstaffing grows instead of stopping at the surplus sign change.
notes: extension parameter: default 0 reproduces Phase 7; 1 in phase9

name: QuitRate
label: Quit rate
description: The yearly fraction of each level's headcount that quits to seek another IT job.

name: R4a
label: Onshore skill erosion
description: The strength of R4 skill erosion onshore: the largest proportional rise in the seeker exit rate for long spells, relative to 2024; 0 turns it off.
notes: term: R4; 0.10 in phase9; evidence range 0 / 0.10 / 0.25

name: R4aIN
label: India skill erosion
description: The strength of R4 skill erosion in India: the largest proportional rise in the seeker exit rate for long spells, relative to 2024; 0 turns it off.
notes: term: R4; 0.10 in phase9, at or below the onshore value

name: RecoveryTime
label: Recovery time
description: The time laid-off people take to recover before they search for work or leave the field.

name: RetireRate_S
label: Senior retirement rate
description: The yearly fraction of senior staff, and of senior recovering and seeking people, who retire.

name: SeekerExitRate
label: Seeker exit rate
description: The yearly fraction of job seekers who give up on IT at normal job prospects.
notes: fitted in calibration (spec 07:86)

name: StudentPerceptionTime
label: Student perception time
description: The time over which prospective students' perception of unemployment catches up with the actual rate.

name: StudyTime
label: Study time
description: The length of study in an IT programme before graduation.

name: SwitchElasticity
label: Switching wage elasticity
description: The elasticity of job switching to the destination-to-source wage ratio.

name: SwitchMax
label: Switching wage-effect cap
description: The cap on the wage effect that scales job switching.
notes: spec 03:220 says dimensionless; it caps the factor that multiplies SwitchRate, so multiplier

name: SwitchRate
label: Job switch rate
description: The base yearly fraction of staff who switch directly to another unit in the same labour pool, before the wage effect.

name: UnempPerceptionTime
label: Unemployment perception time
description: The time over which workers' perception of unemployment catches up with the actual rate.

name: VisaTenure
label: Visa tenure
description: The average time before a visa holder's visa expires.

name: Wage
label: Relative wage
description: The relative wage of each unit within its labour pool, which steers job switching; not the finance auxiliary `Wage`, the yearly USD wage by unit and level.
notes: a relative level, not 1 in 2024 for every unit (GCC 1.3); only ratios within a pool matter; Wage_OV is unused as OV never switches

name: AICost2024
label: AI cost 2024
description: The 2024 AI tooling and enablement cost per unit of work that AI saves, the starting level of AI cost per unit.
notes: fitted in every shipped model; spec 07 gives USD per BFY saved; also read by adoption (cost effect)

name: AICostDecline
label: AI cost decline
description: The yearly fractional fall in AI cost per unit of work, which also drives the fall in consumer credit cost.
notes: spec unit 1/yr; also read by consumer (CreditCostPB)

name: AIDiscCeil
label: AI discount ceiling
description: The largest AI discount clients can extract on new contract prices: the price anchor cannot fall below one minus it (loop R6, C6); 0 turns it off.
notes: term: C6; strength parameter, 0 (off) by default, 0.3 in phase9

name: AIShockEnd
label: AI shock end
description: The calendar year the AI cost shock window closes; the shock no longer applies from this year on.

name: AIShockMult
label: AI cost shock multiplier
description: A test lever multiplying AI cost per unit inside the AI cost shock window, 1 for no shock.

name: AIShockStart
label: AI shock start
description: The calendar year the AI cost shock window opens; the shock applies from this year up to, but not including, its end year.

name: AnnuityAnchorW
label: Annuity anchor exponent
description: The exponent of the client price anchor on the annuity part of new time-and-materials prices (the E2a annuity pricing term).
notes: extension parameter: default 0; an exponent, [0, 1] by meaning; 0.4 in the phase8 and phase9 models

name: AnnuityShare
label: Annuity share
description: The share of new time-and-materials signings that is annuity work and so carries the client price anchor (the E2a annuity pricing term).
notes: extension parameter: default 0 reproduces Phase 7; 0.3 in the phase8 and phase9 models

name: BargainW0
label: Base vendor weight
description: The vendor's weight in the contract-type choice at normal bargaining power, against the client's weight of one minus it.
notes: the spec unit column says fraction; weight because it weights vendor against client utility (wc = 1 - wv)

name: BaseDur
label: Base contract duration
description: The length of a new contract of each type without AI price pressure, also the length over which legacy contracts expire.

name: BaseWage
label: Base wage
description: The fully loaded yearly pay of a mid-level person in each employment unit at wage index 1, before the level multiplier.
units: USD per model-unit person per year
notes: spec unit USD/person/yr; per model-unit person because the wage times headcount plus onboarding (model units) gives LabourCost in USD per year; also read by sourcing (CostOpt)

name: ConsSens
label: Client utility sensitivity
description: The client's utility loss per unit of expected overpayment over a contract term, in the contract-type choice.

name: CostProgramSens
label: Cost programme sensitivity
description: The labour savings a vendor seeks per unit of viability shortfall below its normal margin, beyond the deadband.

name: CostProgramTime
label: Cost programme time
description: The time a vendor's cost programme takes to reach its savings target.

name: Deadband
label: Margin deadband
description: The deviation of a vendor's viability from its normal margin that is ignored before discounts, cost programmes and wage restraint respond.

name: DiscAdjTime
label: Discount adjustment time
description: The time a vendor's competitive discount takes to follow its target.

name: DurPowerElast
label: Duration power elasticity
description: The elasticity of new-contract length to vendor bargaining power.
notes: an exponent of Power

name: DurPUSens
label: Duration price sensitivity
description: How strongly the expected yearly fall in cost per unit of work shortens new contracts.
notes: it multiplies PU (fraction per year) in 1 + DurPUSens x PU, so it is in years, as the spec unit column says

name: EffortDistrust
label: Effort billing distrust
description: The share of perceived AI gains clients expect to lose under effort billing (time and materials, staff augmentation), a penalty in the contract-type choice.

name: GCCOverhead
label: GCC overhead
description: GCC management, facilities and setup cost as a fraction of GCC labour cost, added in services spend and the GCC sourcing cost.
notes: also read by sourcing (CostOpt)

name: MaxDisc
label: Maximum discount
description: The ceiling on a vendor's competitive discount on new signings.

name: MaxSavings
label: Maximum cost savings
description: The ceiling on the share of labour cost a vendor's cost programme can save.

name: MinDur
label: Minimum contract duration
description: The floor on new-contract length, which stops repricing pressure (loop R8) from driving terms to zero.

name: MSGlideShare
label: Managed services glide share
description: The share of in-term productivity gains that managed-services contracts pass to the client through glide paths.

name: NormalMargin
label: Normal vendor margin
description: Each vendor's steady-state margin, the reference for its margin responses and the denominator of relative viability.
notes: module finance: the vendor's steady-state margin, read by finance (Dev, Power) and as the R6 reference by sourcing (C4) and workforce (C2)

name: OBGainShare
label: Outcome-based gain share
description: The share of in-term productivity gains that outcome-based contracts pass to the client.

name: OverheadAdjTime
label: Overhead adjustment time
description: The time a vendor's overhead takes to follow its target share of revenue.

name: OverheadRate
label: Overhead rate
description: Each vendor's steady-state overhead as a share of its revenue, the target its overhead stock moves toward.

name: PassThrough
label: Price pass-through
description: The exponent of the client price anchor: the share of client-perceived productivity gains passed into lower new-contract prices.
notes: an exponent, [0, 1] by meaning; 1.0 in phase7, set to 0.75 in the phase8 and phase9 models

name: PowerMax
label: Bargaining power ceiling
description: The upper limit on a vendor's bargaining power.
notes: a bound on Power, a multiplier (it scales BargainW0 and new-contract durations), so in its units; the spec unit column says dimensionless

name: PowerMin
label: Bargaining power floor
description: The lower limit on a vendor's bargaining power.
notes: a bound on Power, a multiplier (it scales BargainW0 and new-contract durations), so in its units; the spec unit column says dimensionless

name: PowerSens
label: Bargaining power sensitivity
description: The change in a vendor's bargaining power per unit of viability deviation from its normal margin.

name: Price
label: Unit price of work
description: The price a client pays per unit of work delivered by each vendor unit, before the vendor price multiplier and the contract price index.
notes: vendor units only; in-house and GCC units have no price

name: PriceFloor
label: New-bid price floor
description: The floor on each new-bid price as a multiple of the vendor's expected cost per unit of work (loop R6); 0 turns it off.
notes: term: C5; strength parameter, 0 (off) by default, 1.0 in phase9

name: PriceHorizon
label: Client price horizon
description: The years of client-perceived productivity trend that clients price into the anchor for new contract prices.
notes: fitted in every shipped model

name: PriceMult
label: Vendor price multiplier
description: A calibrated factor on each vendor's unit prices that brings its 2024 margin to its target.
notes: calibrated

name: PriceShock
label: Price shock
description: A test lever: the share of each vendor's revenue lost from the price-shock year onward, 0 by default.

name: PriceShockYear
label: Price shock year
description: The calendar year from which each vendor's price shock cuts its revenue.

name: R10rc
label: Attrition replacement cost
