description: The years of wage a vendor pays to replace each voluntary exit above its 2024 attrition rate (loop R10); 0 turns it off.
notes: term: R10; strength parameter, 0 (off) by default, 0.1816 in phase9

name: R6MargTime
label: Margin signal time
description: The smoothing time of the vendor margin signal behind relative viability, read by the vendor-stress terms of loop R6.
notes: term: C2, C4; shape parameter, inert while R6e and kViab are 0; smooths the stock VMarg

name: R6Theta
label: Viability stress threshold
description: The relative-viability threshold, as a fraction of the normal margin, below which vendor capacity exit and client flight begin (loop R6).
notes: term: C2, C4; shape parameter, inert while R6e and kViab are 0; compared with Vrel = VMarg / NormalMargin (1 at 2024); read by C2 (workforce), C4 (sourcing) and the C4Hab smoothing; module finance: a threshold on relative viability, a fraction of the normal margin, though no finance code reads it

name: RivalSens
label: Rival bidding sensitivity
description: The discount a vendor targets per unit of viability above its normal margin beyond the deadband, as rivals bid margins away.

name: SalesCostRate
label: Sales cost rate
description: Sales cost as a share of the yearly value of the contracts a vendor signs.
notes: spec unit fraction; it multiplies Revenue (USD per year) by SignRate (fraction per year), taking Revenue x SignRate as the yearly value signed, so strictly it also carries a factor of years

name: SATTFSens
label: Staff augmentation TTF sensitivity
description: The extra appeal of staff augmentation in the contract-type choice when onshore time to fill is above normal.

name: ShareLossSens
label: Share loss sensitivity
description: The discount a vendor targets per unit of relative work-share loss, while it can afford it (loop B12).

name: ShareRefTime
label: Reference share time
description: The time a vendor's idea of its normal work share takes to adapt to its actual share.

name: TargetMargin
label: Target margin
description: Each vendor's target 2024 margin, an input to the calibration only; the engine never reads it.
notes: unused by the engine (calibration input only)

name: TypeASC
label: Contract type constant
description: The calibrated constant in each vendor's contract-type logit, set so the choice reproduces its 2024 signing shares, by vendor and contract type.
notes: calibrated; the spec unit column says dimensionless; logit units because it is added to the contract-type logit score

name: VendSens
label: Vendor utility sensitivity
description: The vendor's utility per unit of profit change relative to its normal margin, in the contract-type choice.

name: ViabilityTime
label: Viability smoothing time
description: The time over which a vendor's margin is smoothed into its viability index.

name: VisaComplianceCost
label: Visa compliance cost
description: The yearly legal and compliance cost per onsite visa (OV) head, charged to OIT only.
units: USD per model-unit person per year
notes: spec unit USD/person/yr; it multiplies OV headcount in model units

name: VisaFeePerHire
label: Visa fee per hire
description: The one-off visa fee a vendor pays for each new onsite visa (OV) hire, charged to OIT only.
notes: spec unit USD/hire; it multiplies OV hires (model-unit persons per year) to give visa cost in USD per year

name: WageAdjTime
label: Wage adjustment time
description: The time each unit's wage index takes to move toward its target.

name: WageElasticity
label: Wage elasticity
description: The elasticity of each unit's wage-index target to labour-market tightness, normal over perceived unemployment in its labour pool.

name: WageMax
label: Wage index ceiling
description: The ceiling on every unit's wage-index target.
notes: a bound on the wage index WI (1 for every unit in 2024), so in its units; the spec unit column says dimensionless

name: WageMin
label: Wage index floor
description: The floor on every unit's wage-index target.
notes: a bound on the wage index WI (1 for every unit in 2024), so in its units; the spec unit column says dimensionless

name: WageMult
label: Level pay multiplier
description: The pay of each staff level (junior, mid, senior) relative to mid level, applied to every unit's base wage.
notes: also read by sourcing (average wage multiplier)

name: WageRestraint
label: Vendor wage restraint
description: The cut in a vendor unit's wage-index target per unit of viability shortfall below its normal margin, beyond the deadband.

name: WagesEndogenous
label: Endogenous wages switch
description: Model option: 1 lets each unit's wage index respond to unemployment and vendor margin pressure; 0 holds every wage index at 1.
notes: on when at least 0.5

name: C4Cap
label: Client flight cap
description: The largest sourcing value a vendor can lose to client flight, with 0 meaning no cap.
notes: term: C4; a shape parameter, inert while kViab is 0

name: C4FadeTime
label: Client flight fade time
description: The time over which clients habituate to a vendor's viability shortfall, so client flight fades under constant distress.
notes: term: C4; a shape parameter, inert while kViab is 0

name: CapSens
label: Capacity penalty sensitivity
description: The sourcing value an option loses per unit by which its labour pool's time to fill exceeds normal.
notes: spec unit 'dimensionless'; it scales a dimensionless quantity into the sourcing value (a logit), so logit units

name: Contest
label: Contested share
description: The share of reviewed or expiring work actually put out to sourcing choice; the rest stays with the incumbent.

name: CostRef
label: Reference sourcing cost
description: The 2024 in-house cost per unit of work, held fixed, against which option costs are scaled in the sourcing value.

name: ExitPenalty
label: Exit risk penalty
description: The extra sourcing value a vendor loses per point of viability below the exit threshold.
notes: spec unit 'dimensionless'; it scales a dimensionless quantity into the sourcing value (a logit), so logit units

name: ExitThreshold
label: Vendor exit threshold
description: The vendor viability (smoothed margin) below which clients treat the vendor as a going-concern risk.

name: FreezeSourcing
label: Freeze sourcing switch
description: A model option that, when on, stops the sourcing work shares and perceived sourcing shares from updating.
notes: the sourcing stocks update only while it is below 0.5

name: GCCAISens
label: GCC AI sensitivity
description: The extra GCC sourcing value per unit of sector consumer AI adoption above its 2024 level.
notes: the spec gives no unit; it scales an adoption gap (fraction) into the sourcing value (a logit), so logit units

name: GCCMomentum
label: GCC momentum
description: The logit tilt toward GCC applied to every sector's perceived sourcing shares at the start of the run, for the GCC build-out decided before 2024.
notes: fitted in every shipped model

name: GCCReviewTime
label: GCC review time
description: The average time between sourcing reviews of GCC work.

name: IHReviewTime
label: In-house review time
description: The average time between sourcing reviews of in-house work.

name: kR7
label: GCC scale learning strength
description: The strength of loop R7: the logit gain in every sector's GCC value per unit of log growth in the economy-wide GCC work share since 2024.
notes: term: R7; 0 is off (the extension default), 0.4 in phase9

name: kViab
label: Client flight strength
description: The strength of loop C4: the sourcing value a vendor loses per unit of relative-viability shortfall not yet habituated.
notes: term: C4; domains.csv gives logit units per unit of shortfall, a dimensionless quantity; 0 is off, 5.8562 in phase9

name: R7Lcap
label: R7 log cap
description: The cap on the size of the log change in the GCC work share that loop R7 uses.
notes: term: R7; a shape parameter, inert while kR7 is 0

name: RegFitSens
label: Regulatory fit sensitivity
description: The sourcing value an offshore option loses per unit of regulatory drag times consumer AI adoption times offshore exposure.
notes: the spec gives no unit; it scales a dimensionless product into the sourcing value (a logit), so logit units

name: SrcASC
label: Sourcing option constant
description: The calibrated non-cost value of each employer option in each sector, such as proximity, control and setup barriers, with OIT as the zero reference.
notes: spec unit 'dimensionless'; domains.csv calls it a logit constant of the sourcing value, so logit units

name: SrcCostSens
label: Sourcing cost sensitivity
description: The sourcing value lost per unit of an option's cost relative to the reference cost.
notes: spec unit 'dimensionless'; it scales a dimensionless quantity into the sourcing value (a logit), so logit units

name: SrcPerceptionTime
label: Sourcing perception time
description: The delay before perceived sourcing shares catch up with the sourcing targets.

name: ViabSens
label: Viability risk sensitivity
description: The sourcing value a vendor loses per point of weak viability beyond the dead band.
notes: spec unit 'dimensionless'; it scales a dimensionless quantity into the sourcing value (a logit), so logit units

name: VisaRiskSens
label: Visa risk sensitivity
description: The sourcing value OIT loses per unit of perceived visa tightness above its 2024 level.
notes: spec unit 'dimensionless'; it scales a dimensionless quantity into the sourcing value (a logit), so logit units

name: AdoptMult
label: Employer adoption multiplier
description: A per-employer multiplier on the Bass innovation rate p, so in-house teams start slower and boutiques faster.
notes: one member per employer: AdoptMult_IH, _GCC, _OIT, _GSI, _BQ

name: CEMax
label: Cost effect ceiling
description: The upper bound on the adoption cost effect, shared by delivery and consumer AI adoption.
notes: spec unit dimensionless; it bounds the cost-effect multiplier, so multiplier

name: CEMin
label: Cost effect floor
description: The lower bound on the adoption cost effect, shared by delivery and consumer AI adoption.
notes: spec unit dimensionless; it bounds the cost-effect multiplier, so multiplier

name: CostAdoptElast
label: Cost adoption elasticity
description: The elasticity of AI adoption speed to the ratio of labour cost to AI cost, shared by delivery and consumer AI adoption.
notes: an exponent; also read by consumer adoption

name: LabourCostPB0
label: 2024 labour unit cost
description: Each employer's 2024 labour cost per unit of effective staff capacity, the reference level for the adoption cost effect.
units: USD per model-unit person per year
notes: calibrated; flagged level_2024 in domains.csv; one member per employer; unit as the slice 10a catalogue fix (decision 6): labour cost per effective person-year, equal to USD per BFY only while WorkPerPerson and Pe are 1

name: p
label: Bass innovation rate
description: The Bass innovation rate of delivery AI adoption, the yearly fraction of non-adopting work that adopts independently of existing adopters.
notes: spec unit 1/yr; fitted

name: PushSens
label: Share-loss push sensitivity
description: The extra vendor AI adoption speed per unit of relative work-share loss.
notes: a sensitivity

name: q
label: Bass imitation rate
description: The Bass imitation rate of delivery AI adoption, the yearly adoption pull per unit of existing adoption on the non-adopting share.
notes: spec unit 1/yr; fitted

name: TMBrake
label: T&M brake strength
description: How much a vendor's AI adoption speed falls per unit of effort-billed share of its contract book, the strength of the T&M paradox.
notes: a sensitivity in [0, 1]; loop B2; lever

name: AC0
label: 2024 consumer adoption
description: The 2024 share of firms scaling consumer AI, the level from which AI effects on LOB work, AI build and GCC value are measured.
notes: should equal the initial AC stock (0.3)

name: AdoptC0
label: 2024 consumer adoption rate
description: The consumer AI adoption rate already under way in 2024, derived from the Bass parameters, so AI build demand is zero in 2024.
notes: derived: recomputed by Params.with_overrides when pC, qC or AC0 change

name: AISeatPrice
label: AI seat add-on price
description: The yearly price of the AI add-on for one billed seat that has it.
notes: unit addition (slice 10a): seats because the spec counts seats (one per LOB or consumer IT person, so numerically model-unit persons); 'seat' is its singular after per

name: aL_2024
label: 2024 LOB automatable share
description: The share of line-of-business work that AI could automate in 2024.

name: aL_max
label: Max LOB automatable share
description: The ceiling that the automatable share of line-of-business work approaches over time.

name: AppDisplacement
label: App displacement strength
description: How strongly AI agents displace new application builds as AI exposure rises.
notes: loop B9 (application displacement)

name: AppLife
label: Application life
description: The average life of a business application, which sets the base rates of new builds and retirements.

name: ApprovalSens
label: Approval sensitivity
description: The cut in approved discretionary demand per unit of overspend of the budget.
notes: loop B11 (budget crowding-out)

name: Att0
label: 2024 seat attach
description: The 2024 share of seats with an AI add-on, kept for reference but never read by the engine.
notes: unused: the initial Att stock comes from the baseline state

name: BaseDemand
label: Base IT demand
description: The yearly volume of new IT work arriving in 2024, before sector shares, growth and work-type mix.

name: BaseSeatPrice
label: Base seat price
description: The yearly price of devices and per-seat software for one billed seat.
notes: unit addition (slice 10a): seats because the spec counts seats (one per LOB or consumer IT person, so numerically model-unit persons); 'seat' is its singular after per

name: Budget0
label: 2024 IT budget
description: The 2024 IT budget of each sector, grown each year and compared with committed IT spend.
notes: spec unit USD million/yr; the engine holds USD (values near 3.3e9), as the catalogue Budget lines (USD per year)

name: BudgetCycle
label: Budget cycle
description: The smoothing time of the ratio of committed spend to budget.

name: BudgetShock
label: Budget shock
description: The fractional cut in IT budget growth during the budget shock window, a downturn lever.

name: BudgetShockEnd
label: Budget shock end
description: The year the budget shock ends, excluded from the shock window.

name: BudgetShockStart
label: Budget shock start
description: The year the budget shock begins.

name: BuildRate
label: AI build rate
description: The AI project work generated per unit of consumer adoption flow above its 2024 rate, as a share of base demand.
notes: spec unit dimensionless; it multiplies an adoption rate (fraction per year), so strictly years; loop R2 (AI begets IT work)

name: CloudAISens
label: Cloud AI sensitivity
description: How much cloud spend per unit of work rises as AI does more of the work.

name: CloudPerBFY
label: Cloud spend per BFY
description: The 2024 cloud spend per unit of IT work completed, before the AI uplift.

name: CostPerBFY0
label: 2024 services cost
description: The 2024 consumer cost of IT services per unit of work completed, so the cost index is 1 in 2024.
notes: calibrated

name: CostPerceptionTime
label: Cost perception time
description: The delay before consumers notice changes in the cost of IT services work.

name: CreditCost2024
label: 2024 AI credit cost
description: The 2024 cost in AI credits of one FTE-year of line-of-business work done by agents, falling over time with AI cost.
notes: agent work is LOB headcount displaced, counted as BFY a year (spec)

name: CyberEnd
label: Cyber demand end level
description: The multiplier on security demand from AI-driven cyber threats once the cyber ramp is complete; 1 means no change.

name: CyberRampEnd
label: Cyber ramp end
description: The year the cyber threat multiplier on security demand reaches its end level.

name: CyberStart
label: Cyber ramp start
description: The year the cyber threat multiplier on security demand starts to ramp up.

name: DemandStep
label: Demand step
description: A one-off proportional change in base demand from the step year onwards, used for testing.
notes: spec unit fraction; a relative change, so it may be negative (down to -1)

name: GCCAppealEnd
label: Peak GCC appeal
description: The extra sourcing value of GCCs reached at the end of the ramp, the size of the GCC wave.
notes: spec unit dimensionless; GCCAppeal is added to the GCC sourcing value (logit scale), so logit units; fitted

name: GCCAppealKeep
label: GCC appeal kept
description: The share of the peak GCC appeal that remains after the fade; 1 keeps the whole wave.
notes: factor on GCCAppealEnd; natural range 0-1, but EXTREME uses 2 (appeal grows), so multiplier, not fraction

name: GCCFadeEnd
label: GCC fade end
description: The year the GCC appeal finishes fading to its kept share of the peak.

name: GCCRampEnd
label: GCC ramp end
description: The year the extra GCC appeal reaches its full level and starts to fade.

name: GCCRampStart
label: GCC ramp start
description: The year the extra appeal of GCCs starts to ramp up from zero.

name: GovRegSens
label: Governance demand sensitivity
description: The extra governance work per unit of regulatory drag times consumer adoption.

name: ITBudgetGrowth
label: IT budget growth
description: The real yearly growth rate of IT budgets, a macro lever on top of economic growth.
notes: spec unit 1/yr; a 2024-anchored rate (rule anchored_rate)

name: JevonsCap
label: Jevons cap
description: The largest demand multiplier the Jevons effect can give app, data and AI build demand.
notes: spec unit dimensionless; it caps the multiplier Jev, so multiplier

name: JevonsEps
label: Jevons elasticity
description: The elasticity of app and data demand to the perceived cost of IT work, the strength of the Jevons rebound; 0 switches it off.
notes: loop R3 (Jevons effect)

name: Leakage
label: Credit leakage
description: The share of AI credit spend that goes straight to AI model providers, kept from the spec but never read by the engine.
notes: unused: spec feeds only the output AIProviderSpend, which the engine does not record

name: LOB0
label: 2024 LOB headcount
description: The 2024 line-of-business headcount of each sector, the business staff whose work AI agents can automate.
notes: spec unit persons; catalogue LOB lines are model-unit persons, and LOB0 is added to consumer IT heads in Seats; should equal the initial LOB stock

name: LOBAdjTime
label: LOB adjustment time
description: The time over which LOB headcount closes its gap to its target, mostly through attrition.

name: MigWeight
label: Migration share of DATA
description: The share of data work driven by application retirements and migrations.
notes: a blend weight; spec unit fraction

name: MinAdoptionTime
label: Minimum adoption time
description: The shortest time in which an adoption fraction may close its gap to 1, a cap that keeps adoption at or below full.
notes: shared: also caps delivery AI adoption (adoption.py), consumer adoption AC and seat attach Att

name: MinApproval
label: Minimum approval
description: The floor on the approval of discretionary IT demand, however far spend exceeds the budget.
notes: loop B11 (budget crowding-out)

name: NewAppWeight
label: New-app share of APP
description: The share of app development work that builds new applications, the rest enhancing the existing portfolio.
notes: a blend weight; spec unit fraction

name: NormalUtil
label: Normal budget utilisation
description: The normal ratio of committed spend to budget, used in calibrating the 2024 budgets but never read by the engine.
notes: unused at run time; spec divides 2024 committed spend by it to set Budget0

name: pAtt
label: Seat attach innovation
description: The Bass innovation rate of AI seat attach, the yearly fraction of seats without AI that add it unprompted.
notes: spec unit 1/yr; fitted

name: pC
label: Consumer adoption innovation
description: The Bass innovation rate of consumer AI adoption, the yearly fraction of non-adopting firms that adopt unprompted.
notes: spec unit 1/yr; fixed at 0.005 in Phase 7

name: Port0
label: 2024 application portfolio
description: The 2024 number of business applications in each sector's portfolio, the reference for new builds and portfolio-driven demand.
notes: unit addition (slice 10a): applications because the portfolio is a count of applications (spec unit column); should equal the initial Port stock

name: qAtt
label: Seat attach imitation
description: The Bass imitation rate of AI seat attach, the yearly pull from seats that already have the AI add-on.
notes: spec unit 1/yr

name: qC
label: Consumer adoption imitation
description: The Bass imitation rate of consumer AI adoption, the yearly adoption pull from firms that already use AI.
notes: spec unit 1/yr; fitted

name: RegEnd
label: Regulation ramp end
description: The year regulatory drag on consumer AI adoption reaches its full level.

name: RegScenario
label: Regulation scenario
description: The scenario multiplier on regulatory drag: 0 light-touch, 1 base, 1.5 strict.

name: RegStart
label: Regulation ramp start
description: The year regulatory drag on consumer AI adoption starts to ramp in.

name: ReinvestAdoptSens
label: Reinvestment adoption boost
description: The extra speed of consumer AI adoption at full reinvestment of savings relative to the budget.
notes: loop R1 (savings reinvestment)

name: ReinvestFrac
label: Reinvested savings share
description: The share of net LOB savings that firms add to their IT budget.
notes: loop R1 (savings reinvestment)

name: RetireAccel
label: Retirement acceleration
description: The extra application retirement rate at full AI exposure, relative to the normal rate.
notes: applications retired, not people; loop B9 (application displacement)

name: RunRate
label: AI run rate
description: The ongoing work of running AI at full adoption above the 2024 level, as a share of base demand.
notes: loop R2 (AI begets IT work)

name: SeatAdjTime
label: Seat adjustment time
description: The lag of billed seats behind actual seats, as refreshes and renewals catch up.
notes: loop B10 (seat contraction)

name: Seats0
label: 2024 seats
description: The 2024 number of seats in each sector, LOB staff plus the sector's in-house and GCC IT staff, the reference for end-user support demand.
notes: unit addition (slice 10a): seats because the spec counts seats (one per LOB or consumer IT person, so numerically model-unit persons); should equal the initial SeatsB stock

name: StepYear
label: Demand step year
description: The calendar year from which the demand step applies.

name: SupPortShare
label: Portfolio share of SUP
description: The share of support work that scales with the application portfolio.
notes: a blend weight; spec unit fraction

name: a2024
label: 2024 automatable share
description: The share of each work type that AI could automate in 2024, the starting point of the automatable share.
notes: flagged level_2024

name: amax
label: Automatable share ceiling
description: The ceiling that the automatable share of each work type approaches as AI capability grows.
notes: an anchored rate: may not differ from the baseline when perturb_from is after 2024

name: SpeedUp
label: AI speed-up
description: How many times faster AI performs the automatable part of each work type.
notes: spec unit dimensionless; a factor on the speed of automated work, so multiplier

name: Mix0
label: 2024 contract mix
description: The 2024 share of each vendor's contract book in each contract type, by volume; the engine never reads it, as the baseline state already holds it.
notes: unused by run(); each vendor row sums to 1 and equals the 2024 Leg state

name: OffExp
label: Offshore exposure
description: Each employer option's degree of offshore delivery, which scales its regulatory-fit penalty in the sourcing value.
notes: domains.csv bounds it to [0, 1] and the spec gives no unit; read as the offshore part of the option's delivery

name: Src0
label: 2024 sourcing mix
description: The 2024 shares of each sector's work by employer, which the baseline state already holds; the engine never reads it.
notes: each sector row sums to 1; IHW, GCCW and VW start at these values

name: BuildMix
label: AI build mix
description: The split of AI project work across work types.
notes: entries sum to 1

name: LOBWage
label: LOB wage
description: The blended yearly pay of one line-of-business employee in each sector, India and onshore together.
units: USD per model-unit person per year
notes: spec unit USD/person/yr; it multiplies LOB headcount (model-unit persons) to give USD a year

name: RegDragLevel
label: Regulatory drag level
description: Each sector's cut in consumer AI adoption speed once regulation fully applies, in the base scenario.

name: SectorShare
label: Sector share of demand
description: Each sector's share of 2024 IT work, which splits base demand across sectors.
notes: also the fallback completion share when nothing completes

name: WTMix
label: Work-type mix
description: The 2024 split of IT work across work types, the same in every sector.
notes: entries sum to 1

name: G
label: Demand growth multiplier
description: The recorded underlying demand growth multiplier, 1 in 2024; shares its name with the auxiliary `G`, which it records.
notes: catalogue unit 'index' (2024 = 1) mapped to index (2024 = 1)

name: Backlog
label: Total backlog
description: The total IT backlog, summed over sectors and work types.
notes: reads the auxiliary TotBL

name: CapE_{employer}
label: Delivery capacity
description: The IT work each employer could complete a year at its current productivity and effective staff, an extra output.

name: CompE_{employer}
label: Employer work completed
description: IT work completed a year by each employer.

name: Completion
label: Total work completed
description: Total IT work completed a year by all employers; shares its name with the auxiliary `Completion`, which it records.

name: CompS_{sector}
label: Sector work completed
description: IT work completed a year in each sector by all employers.

name: P_all
label: Realised productivity
description: Realised delivery productivity, completion over effort across employers, 1 in 2024; shares its name with the auxiliary `P_all`, which it records.
notes: catalogue unit 'index' (1 in 2024) mapped to index (2024 = 1)

name: P_{employer}
label: Employer productivity
description: Each employer's work-weighted delivery productivity relative to 2024.
notes: catalogue unit 'index' (relative to 2024) mapped to index (2024 = 1)

name: VendorWorkShare
label: Vendor work share
description: The three vendors' combined share of all completed IT work, equal to one minus the in-house and GCC shares.
notes: catalogue unit 'share' mapped to fraction; a derived output

name: WorkShare_{employer}
label: Employer work share
description: Each employer's share of all completed IT work, its sector work shares weighted by each sector's share of completion.
notes: catalogue unit 'share' mapped to fraction

name: VisaTight
label: Visa tightness
description: The recorded visa policy tightness, from 0 open to 1 closed, ramping from VTBase to VTEnd; shares its name with the auxiliary `VisaTight` it records.
notes: catalogue unit 'index' mapped to dimensionless: on the 0-1 visa tightness scale (0 open, 1 closed; 0.3 in 2024), which is not 1 in 2024, so dimensionless

name: Ext_total
label: Total external entry
description: Experienced mid and senior entrants from outside IT a year, summed over both regions.
notes: catalogue unit (inferred) used as is

name: Grad_total
label: Total graduates
description: Graduates entering the junior seeker pools a year, summed over both regions.
notes: catalogue unit (inferred) used as is

name: H_{unit}
label: Unit headcount
description: Headcount of one employment unit over all levels, excluding onboarding staff.

name: Head_{employer}
label: Employer headcount
description: Headcount of one employer, the sum of its units over all levels, excluding onboarding staff.

name: HeadLoc_{region}
label: Headcount by location
description: Headcount located in one region, with visa holders counted onshore, equal to the consumer plus vendor Q1 lines of that region.

name: HeadTotal
label: Total IT headcount
description: All IT headcount across the eight units and three levels, equal to the sum of the four Q1 lines, excluding onboarding staff.

name: HireJ_{region}
label: Junior hires
description: Junior hires a year from one regional labour pool, summed over the units that hire from it.
notes: catalogue unit (inferred) used as is

name: IndiaPeople
label: India IT people
description: India IT employment in real people: the consumer and vendor India lines, each scaled by its own ratio to 2024, summed.
notes: real people scaled by INDIA_SCALE, not model units

name: IndiaPeople_ConsIndia
label: India consumer IT people
description: The India consumer IT (GCC) line in real people: 1.90 million times its ratio to 2024.
notes: real people scaled by INDIA_SCALE, not model units

name: IndiaPeople_VendIndia
label: India vendor IT people
description: The India vendor IT line in real people: 3.53 million times its ratio to 2024.
notes: real people scaled by INDIA_SCALE, not model units

name: IndiaTotal
label: India headcount
description: India IT headcount: the consumer and vendor India Q1 lines combined, equal to headcount located in India.

name: JuniorHiringRatio
label: Junior hiring ratio
description: Junior hires from both labour pools relative to their 2024 value.
notes: catalogue unit 'ratio (2024 = 1)' mapped to index (2024 = 1); needs record_every at most 0.25

name: LeftField_{region}
label: Left the field
description: A running total of people who have left the IT field, for one regional labour pool.

name: OnshoreTotal
label: Onshore headcount
description: Onshore IT headcount: the consumer and vendor onshore Q1 lines combined, equal to headcount located onshore.

name: Q1_ConsIndia
label: Consumer IT India
description: The Q1 line for consumer IT in India: GCC headcount.

name: Q1_ConsOnshore
label: Consumer IT onshore
description: The Q1 line for consumer IT onshore: in-house headcount.

name: Q1_VendIndia
label: Vendor IT India
description: The Q1 line for vendor IT in India: OIT and GSI India headcount.

name: Q1_VendOnshore
label: Vendor IT onshore
description: The Q1 line for vendor IT onshore: OIT visa holders and local staff, GSI onshore and BQ headcount.

name: SkillErosionMult_{region}_{level}
label: Skill erosion multiplier
description: The R4 skill-erosion multiplier on seeker exits for one region and level, relative to its 2024 value; 1 while that region's R4 strength is 0.
notes: term: R4; catalogue unit 'ratio (1 at 2024)' mapped to index (2024 = 1)

name: TTF_{region}_{level}
label: Time to fill
description: Time to fill in one regional labour pool at one level: pool vacancies over yearly fills, with fills floored at one a year.

name: Unemp_{region}
label: Unemployment rate
description: The IT unemployment rate of one regional labour pool, with visa holders counted in the India pool.
notes: catalogue unit 'fraction' (inferred) used as is

name: VendorHead
label: Vendor headcount
description: Headcount of the three vendors OIT, GSI and BQ, equal to the two vendor Q1 lines combined.
notes: spec 04:117 sums VI, OV and OL only, before the SI and BQ units existed

name: AICost_{vendor}
label: Vendor AI cost
description: Each vendor's yearly AI tooling and enablement cost on the AI-automated share of its delivered work.

name: AIDiscCeilBinds_{vendor}
label: AI discount ceiling binds
description: 1 at a step where the loop R6 AI-discount ceiling raises a vendor's client price anchor, else 0; always 0 while the ceiling is off.
notes: term: C6

name: AvgIdx_{vendor}
label: Book price index
description: The price index of each vendor's in-force contract book, 1 in 2024, with effort-billed types deflated by productivity.
notes: catalogue unit 'index' mapped to index (2024 = 1): the catalogue says 2024 = 1, and in 2024 the new-vintage stocks are empty and productivity is 1

name: AvgNewDur_{vendor}
label: Average new duration
description: Each vendor's average new-contract duration, weighted by the contract-type shares of its new signings.

name: BaseRev_{vendor}
label: Vendor base revenue
description: Each vendor's yearly revenue at base unit prices and its price multiplier, before the book price index and any price shock.

name: Book_{vendor}_{type}
label: Contract book
description: Each vendor's in-force contract book by type, legacy plus new, normalised so that its 2024 total book is 1.
notes: catalogue unit 'book volume (vendor 2024 book = 1)' mapped to book volume; spec 00 names the contract stocks in USD, but the calibrated state normalises each vendor's 2024 book to 1

name: Del_{unit}
label: Work delivered by unit
description: Work delivered by each employment unit: its employer's completed work split over its units by effective staff.

name: Disc_{vendor}
label: Competitive discount
description: Each vendor's competitive price discount on new signings, which follows its target (loop B12).
notes: reads the stock Disc

name: Dnew_{vendor}_{type}
label: New contract duration
description: The duration of each vendor's new contracts by type, shortened by price uncertainty and lengthened by bargaining power, floored at the minimum duration.

name: EffortShare_revenue_weighted
label: Revenue-weighted effort share
description: The effort-billed share of the three vendors' contract books, averaged with vendor revenue as weights, since the volume books cannot be added across vendors.
notes: derived output; catalogue unit 'share' mapped to fraction

name: EffortShare_{vendor}
label: Effort-billed share
description: The effort-billed (time and materials plus staff augmentation) share of each vendor's in-force contract book, by volume.
notes: catalogue unit 'share' mapped to fraction

name: ExpRate_{vendor}
label: Expiry rate
description: Each vendor's yearly contract expiries (legacy plus new) per unit of its contract book.
notes: catalogue unit 'rate (per year)' mapped to fraction per year

name: LabCost_{unit}
label: Unit labour cost
description: The yearly labour cost of each employment unit: wages paid on its headcount plus onboarding staff.

name: LabRaw_{vendor}
label: Vendor gross labour cost
description: Each vendor's yearly gross labour cost, summed over its employment units before cost programme savings.

name: Margin_{vendor}
label: Vendor margin
description: Each vendor's margin: revenue less total cost, as a fraction of revenue.

name: Mix_{vendor}_{type}
label: Contract mix
description: The share of each vendor's in-force contract book (legacy plus new) in each contract type, by volume, not value.
notes: catalogue unit 'share' mapped to fraction

name: Overhead_{vendor}
label: Vendor overhead
description: Each vendor's yearly overhead, a stock that lags its overhead rate times revenue.
notes: reads the stock Overhead; spec unit USD/yr

name: PNew_{vendor}_{type}
label: New signing price
description: The price of each vendor's new signings by type per unit of book volume, relative to 2024, after the discount and the loop R6 price rules.
notes: term: C5 (the price floor, when PriceFloor > 0; loops.floor); catalogue unit 'index' mapped to index (2024 = 1): the catalogue says 2024 = 1, and in 2024 the anchor is 1 and the discount 0; for effort types it is a rate that revenue deflates by productivity

name: Power_{vendor}
label: Bargaining power
description: Each vendor's bargaining power, 1 when its viability equals its normal margin and moving with the deviation, within the power floor and ceiling.
notes: catalogue unit 'index' mapped to multiplier: Power scales the vendor weight BargainW0 and, through a power, new-contract durations

name: PriceFloorBinds_{vendor}_{type}
label: Price floor binds
description: 1 at a step where the loop R6 price floor raises a vendor's new-bid price for that contract type, else 0; always 0 while the floor is off.
notes: term: C5

name: PU_{vendor}
label: Price uncertainty
description: Each vendor's price uncertainty: the client-perceived yearly productivity trend, the expected yearly fall in cost per unit of work.
notes: catalogue unit 'rate (per year)' mapped to fraction per year

name: Revenue_{vendor}
label: Vendor revenue
description: Each vendor's yearly revenue in real terms: delivered work at base unit prices, times its book price index, less any price shock.

name: RevenueTot
label: Total vendor revenue
description: Total yearly revenue of the three vendor archetypes; shares its name with the auxiliary `RevenueTot` it records.
notes: name clash: the auxiliary RevenueTot (finance)

name: SalesCost_{vendor}
label: Vendor sales cost
description: Each vendor's yearly sales cost, a share of revenue scaled by its signing rate.

name: ServicesSpend
label: Services spend
description: Yearly consumer IT services spend: in-house and GCC labour cost (GCC with overhead), vendor revenue and consumers' own AI cost; shares its name with the auxiliary `ServicesSpend` it records.
notes: name clash: the auxiliary ServicesSpend (finance)

name: ShareLoss_{vendor}
label: Work share loss
description: The relative shortfall of each vendor's work share below its reference share, 0 when at or above it.

name: Sign_{vendor}_{type}
label: New signing type share
description: The logit share of each contract type in each vendor's new signings.
notes: catalogue unit 'share' mapped to fraction; spec 06b indexes it by vendor and type

name: SignRate_{vendor}
label: Signing rate
description: Each vendor's yearly signings (renewals plus wins) per unit of its contract book.
notes: catalogue unit 'rate (per year)' mapped to fraction per year

name: SignVol_{vendor}_{type}
label: New signings volume
description: Each vendor's yearly new contract signings by type, in book volume.

name: VendDel_{vendor}
label: Vendor work delivered
description: Work delivered by each vendor, summed over its employment units.

name: VendorCost_{vendor}
label: Vendor total cost
description: Each vendor's total yearly cost: net labour, visa, AI, overhead and sales costs, plus attrition replacement cost when loop R10 is on.
notes: term: R10 (the attrition cost is added when R10rc > 0; loops.r10cost)

name: Vi_{vendor}
label: Vendor viability
description: Each vendor's viability index: its margin smoothed over the viability time.
notes: reads the stock Viab

name: VisaCost_{vendor}
label: Vendor visa cost
description: Each vendor's yearly visa fees on new onsite visa hires plus compliance cost on onsite visa staff, non-zero for OIT only.

name: VLab_{vendor}
label: Vendor net labour cost
description: Each vendor's yearly labour cost net of its cost programme savings.

name: VoluntaryAttrition_{vendor}
label: Voluntary attrition ratio
description: Each vendor's voluntary exits per head (quits, leaving the field and switch-outs) relative to 2024, the signal for loop R10's attrition cost.
notes: term: R10; catalogue unit 'ratio (1 at 2024)' mapped to index (2024 = 1); recorded for every model

name: VShare_{vendor}
label: Vendor work share
description: Each vendor's share of all completed IT work, the same as its employer work share.
notes: catalogue unit 'share' mapped to fraction

name: WI_{unit}
label: Wage index
description: Each employment unit's wage index, 1 in 2024, adjusting toward a target set by labour-market tightness and vendor wage restraint.
notes: reads the stock WI

name: ClientFlight_{vendor}
label: Client flight
description: The C4 client-flight term subtracted from each vendor's sourcing value, after the fade and the cap; zero while kViab is 0.
notes: term: C4; an extra

name: Cost_{employer}
label: Sourcing cost by option
description: The sourcing cost per unit of work of each employer option as clients see it.
notes: catalogue unit 'USD per BFY' (inferred), consistent with CostRef in USD/BFY

name: GCCScaleTerm
label: GCC scale learning
description: The recorded R7 term added to every sector's GCC sourcing value, zero while kR7 is 0; shares its name with the auxiliary `GCCScaleTerm` it records.
notes: term: R7; an extra

name: Src_{sector}_{employer}
label: Sourcing share
description: Each employer's share of each sector's IT work, from the in-house, GCC and vendor sourcing stocks.
notes: catalogue unit 'share' mapped to fraction; module sourcing: it records the sourcing stocks IHW, GCCW and VW, re-indexed as EmpShare

name: SrcT_{sector}_{employer}
label: Sourcing target share
description: The logit sourcing target share of each employer in each sector, toward which the perceived shares move.
notes: catalogue unit 'share' mapped to fraction

name: Vrel_{vendor}
label: Relative viability
description: Each vendor's margin smoothed over 0.75 years relative to its normal margin, the R6 signal of capacity exit and client flight.
notes: term: C2, C4; catalogue unit 'ratio (1 at 2024)' mapped to index (2024 = 1); an extra

name: WorkCheck_{sector}
label: Sector work check
description: The sum of each sector's in-house, GCC and vendor work shares, a diagnostic that must stay at 1.
notes: catalogue unit 'share' (inferred) mapped to fraction; a sum of fractions that should equal 1

name: WorkCheckMax
label: Work check deviation
description: The largest deviation of any sector's work check from 1, a work conservation diagnostic that should stay near 0.
notes: catalogue unit 'fraction' (inferred)

name: A_mean
label: Mean delivery adoption
description: Delivery AI adoption averaged over employers, weighted by the work each completes.
notes: module adoption: a completion-weighted mean of the adoption stock A, like A_{employer}

name: A_{employer}
label: Delivery AI adoption
description: Delivery AI adoption of each employer, the recorded value of the adoption stock.

name: LabPB_{employer}
label: Labour cost per capacity
description: Labour cost per unit of effective, level-weighted staff of each employer, which feeds the adoption cost effect.
units: USD per model-unit person per year
notes: unit as the slice 10a catalogue fix (decision 6): labour cost per effective person-year, equal to USD per BFY only while WorkPerPerson and Pe are 1

name: AC_mean
label: Mean consumer AI adoption
description: Consumer AI adoption averaged over sectors, weighted by base sector shares of demand rather than by completed work.

name: AC_{sector}
label: Consumer AI adoption
description: Consumer AI adoption of one sector, the share of its consumers using AI.

name: Att
label: AI seat attach rate
description: The AI seat attach rate, the share of seats with an AI add-on; it shares its name with the stock `Att` and the auxiliary `Att`.

name: Budget
label: Total consumer budget
description: Consumer IT budget a year, all sectors, the grown base plus reinvested savings.

name: Budget_{sector}
label: Consumer IT budget
description: Consumer IT budget of one sector a year.

name: CloudSpend_{sector}
label: Cloud spend
description: Consumer cloud spend of one sector a year, a part of its committed spend.
notes: extra output

name: Committed
label: Total committed spend
description: Committed consumer IT spend a year, all sectors: services share, seats, AI credits and cloud.

name: Committed_{sector}
label: Committed IT spend
description: Committed IT spend of one sector a year: services share, seats, AI credits and cloud.

name: ConsIT
